Internal Review Draft
A medical/legal lead must define the retention schedule, lawful grounds, deletion exceptions, custodians and jurisdictions before production. This draft supplies process boundaries, not invented retention periods.

Classification and Requests
Classify account, professional evidence, clinical, consent, financial, audit and backup records separately. Verify requester identity and authority. Record requests and decisions without copying clinical text into general logs.

Disclosures and Deletion
Distinguish revocation of future access from historic disclosure and record retention. Do not erase immutable encounter snapshots, financial postings, consent history or audit evidence to make a request appear fulfilled. Escalate conflicts and legal holds for authorized decision.

Access and Backups
Least privilege applies to custom and generic APIs, files, reports and exports. Clinic membership does not grant record access. Backup access must be restricted; restoration must preserve security and consent records. Approved retention periods and backup expiry remain pending.

english:
Internal Review Draft
Assign responsible security, clinical and legal contacts, coverage and jurisdiction-specific notification duties before production. This is editable operational boilerplate.

Triage and Containment
Record a neutral incident reference, time, affected system and authorized investigator. Restrict access, preserve relevant evidence and credentials securely, and contain a suspected exposure without broadcasting patient data. Do not log tokens, OTPs or raw clinical bodies.

Assessment and Response
Assess safety, confidentiality, integrity and availability impacts with least privilege. Credential verification and clinical safeguarding decisions remain human-led. Confirm applicable legal reporting and individual notification obligations with counsel; this template supplies no unsupported deadline.

Recovery and Learning
Use verified backups and scoped service procedures. Check record/consent and owner financial reconciliation after recovery. Document decisions, communications, corrective action and authorized closure. Never treat a provider acknowledgement as proof that an individual received a safety message.

Proposed Review Standards
These editable standards require medical-lead and legal approval. They are not a substitute for licensing rules or a representation that a regulator has accredited TeleTena.

Professional Responsibility
Provide truthful qualifications, evidence, current license/registration details where applicable and service-specific competence. Platform reviewers must distinguish applicant claims from verified evidence. Affiliation alone is not clinical competence.

Scope and Conduct
Offer only currently approved services within restrictions, population, language, format and jurisdiction. Do not imply approval for all scopes from general application acceptance. Explain limitations, suitability, fees and disclosure choices professionally.

Records and Boundaries
Protect private documents and encounter-specific notes. Share summaries only with explicitly authorized recipients. Do not record without an approved separate process. Report credential expiry, scope restrictions, safety concerns and potential confidentiality incidents to authorized reviewers.

english:
Review Status and Operator
This editable review template describes the implemented demonstration controls. It is not a claim of legal compliance. The real controller/operator, privacy contact, lawful grounds and jurisdiction-specific notices must be confirmed before real care.

Information Used
Accounts use verified contacts and profile details. Optional history text and private files, professional applications, bookings, requests, encounter disclosures, records and demonstration transaction references serve their stated workflows. Do not provide real clinical information in this review environment.

Purpose and Limited Sharing
Public discovery exposes allowlisted approved profile and offering information only. Open-request recipients see only the authorized request disclosure. The chosen treating clinician receives the immutable encounter disclosure you approve, including individually selected files. Partners, clinics, reviewers and other clinicians do not receive blanket clinical-record access.

Choices and Consent
Name, alias, text history and individual files are separate choices. Defaults can be edited. A global preference is not consent to unknown recipients. Terms acceptance, privacy acknowledgement, care consent and optional marketing are separate records. Revoking future access cannot erase what a recipient previously viewed or automatically settle clinical retention duties.

Providers and Cross-Border Processing
Configured SMS, email and LiveKit services support authentication, neutral notices and calls. Provider acceptance is not proof of delivery. Before production the operator must identify actual providers, hosting locations, transfers, safeguards and contracts. No recording or transcription is enabled by default.

Security and Browser Storage
Private files and clinical APIs require server authorization. Authentication and clinical responses are not cached by the service worker. Guest health drafts stay in tab memory and are lost on refresh; safe opaque navigation intent may be retained. No platform can promise absolute security.

Retention and Individual Requests
Retention periods, deletion exceptions, legal holds, access/correction processes and regulator routes require local governance approval. Contact the configured privacy channel to request review. This template does not invent deadlines or permit silently deleting financial history or disclosed clinical records.

Incidents and Changes
Report suspected unauthorized access through the configured channel without sending clinical material in a general message. Authorized staff must assess containment and applicable notification duties. New document versions preserve earlier acceptance records; policy editing is not a retrospective consent change.

english:
Review Status
This is editable demonstration boilerplate. It is not an approved agreement for real patient care. The legal operator, governing law, jurisdiction, liability provisions and dispute process require qualified local review before activation.

Purpose and Eligibility
TeleTena helps adults aged 18 or older discover published services, request private offers, book consultations and access authorized records. Open requests are not an emergency response service. Clinician approval is a human platform review, not regulatory accreditation or a guarantee of treatment results.

Accounts and Responsibilities
Use your own verified contact and protect your account. Do not impersonate another person, upload unlawful material or attempt unauthorized access. Professional access requires current general and service-specific approval. Navigation intent does not grant a professional role.

Bookings and Requests
Published services show duration, format and price. A request or offer does not reserve a slot. The application rechecks availability, approval, disclosure and funds before booking. Manual confirmation remains pending until accepted. An immediate matching target is not a guarantee.

Demonstration Funds
This environment uses demonstration balances only. A reservation is distinct from a charge, pending earnings, release and payout reservation. No real custody, external transfer, refund or payout is represented by these demonstration events. A future real-money service needs separately approved arrangements and terms.

Consultations and Records
Joining, leaving, ending a call and finalizing documentation are separate actions. Notes are private unless a deliberately shared summary is authorized for you. Each adult participant gives individual consent; paying does not grant another person's records.

Changes, Cancellation and Complaints
The policy snapshot shown at booking governs supported cancellation, confirmation expiry, rescheduling and extensions. Do not assume an automatic refund or no-show penalty. Use the configured support channel for an authorized review. Editing this document does not alter past appointments or policy snapshots.

Before Production
The operator must complete legal identity, contact, pricing, complaint deadlines, consumer rights, jurisdiction and enforcement provisions with counsel. Mandatory rights are not waived by this review template.

Review Template
Contact details in this environment are fictional unless replaced by an authorized reviewer. Do not send urgent or clinical information to a mock channel.

Getting Help
Use account Help & Tours for navigation and the configured support channel for account or booking problems. Provide a neutral booking reference and concise issue description, not passwords, OTPs, private notes or medical attachments.

Review and Escalation
An authorized operator should acknowledge, investigate and record outcomes with least-privilege access. Financial dispute review does not authorize private clinical notes. Actual response deadlines, appeal routes and independent escalation must be agreed before production.

Urgent Safety
TeleTena is not emergency care. Contact local emergency services or a nearby emergency department if immediate safety is at risk. The operator must validate local crisis/safeguarding contacts and clinical escalation procedures before real care.

Review Template
This explanation does not change operational booking policy. Exact accepted price, confirmation mode, expiry and cancellation rules are snapshotted by the booking workflow.

Confirmation and Expiry
An automatic booking may confirm when the protected transaction succeeds. A manual booking stays pending until the clinician responds. A single three-minute email reminder is distinct from the snapshotted confirmation-expiry deadline. Notifications can fail without undoing a valid booking.

Cancellation and Time Changes
Use supported in-app pre-start cancellation or mutual rescheduling. Existing restrictions remain; elapsed appointments are not automatically completed. No-show adjudication and automatic no-show penalties are outside this MVP. Unsupported post-release refund cases need authorized resolution.

Funds and Earnings
Booking reserves demonstration funds. Clinician finalization consumes the reservation once and creates pending earnings under its snapshotted fee/withholding policy. Ending a call alone does not settle. Disputes hold eligible release; payout requests reserve available earnings without implying external transfer.

Production Decisions
Real provider arrangements, mandatory consumer rights, complaint deadlines and refund obligations need explicit legal/provider approval before real-money activation. No payment details should be sent through public enquiries.

Review Template
This information supports, but does not replace, encounter-specific informed consent and professional assessment. Qualified clinical/legal review is required.

Remote Care and Suitability
Audio/video care may be unsuitable for some needs. Connection or device failure may interrupt care. Do not use open requests for emergencies. Discuss suitability, alternatives, risks and limitations with the clinician.

Your Participation
Confirm a private setting and who is present. You may leave a call; leaving is not clinician completion. Each adult in a couples session must accept their own invitation, disclosure and applicable time/extension proposals. Declined or withdrawn consent restricts participation according to the application state.

Information Shared
Review name/alias, history text and each selected file before encounter authorization. Private notes and a patient-shared summary are separate. A partner does not automatically receive your private intake or all summary content.

Time and Charges
Paid extensions require explicit required-participant consent and authorized payer funds before they begin. Connection duration alone is not billing consent. The demonstration involves no real payment or clinical care.

afaan_oromo: Yeroon dhumaa yeroo jalqabaa booda ta'uu qaba.

english: The patient chose what to share for this request. Do not use it outside this response.
amharic: ታካሚው ለዚህ ጥያቄ የሚጋራውን መርጧል። ከዚህ ምላሽ ውጭ አይጠቀሙበት።
afaan_oromo: Dhukkubsataan gaaffii kanaaf waan qoodu filateera. Deebii kanaan ala itti hin fayyadaminaa.

english: The patient will no longer be able to accept this quote.
afaan_oromo: Dhukkubsataan gatii kana fudhachuu hin dandaʼu.

english: This clinician profile is unavailable or no longer approved.
This offer is no longer available. Return to your request to see other options.
amharic: ይህ አቅርቦት ከእንግዲህ አይገኝም። ሌሎችን ለማየት ወደ ጥያቄዎ ይመለሱ።
afaan_oromo: Yaadni kun amma hin jiru. Filannoo biraaf gaaffii keessanitti deebi’aa.

english: This offer is unavailable. Only your own offers can be viewed.
amharic: ይህ ምላሽ አይገኝም። የራስዎን ምላሾች ብቻ ማየት ይችላሉ።
afaan_oromo: Yaadni gatii kun hin jiru. Kan kee qofa ilaaluu dandeessa.

english: This outcome is retained in your history.
This request has no available offers.
afaan_oromo: Gaaffii kanaaf dhiyeessiin jiru hin jiru.

english: This request is no longer available. Only currently eligible requests are shown.
amharic: ይህ ጥያቄ ከእንግዲህ አይገኝም። አሁን ብቁ የሆኑት ብቻ ይታያሉ።
afaan_oromo: Gaaffiin kun amma hin jiru. Gaaffilee amma ulaagaa guutan qofatu agarsiifama.

english: Updates could not be refreshed. Your last saved offer is shown.
amharic: ዝማኔዎች አልተጫኑም። መጨረሻ የተቀመጠው አቅርቦትዎ ይታያል።
afaan_oromo: Odeeffannoo haaromsuun hin danda’amne. Yaadni keessan dhuma olkaa’ame agarsiifama.

english: Updates could not be refreshed. Your last saved request is shown.
amharic: ዝማኔዎች አልተጫኑም። መጨረሻ የተቀመጠው ጥያቄዎ ይታያል።
afaan_oromo: Odeeffannoo haaromsuun hin danda’amne. Gaaffiin keessan dhuma olkaa’ame agarsiifama.

english: We will show eligible clinician offers here.
amharic: ብቁ የሆኑ የሐኪሞችን ቅናሾች እዚህ እናሳያለን።
afaan_oromo: Dhiyeessii ogeessota ulaagaa guutan asitti ni agarsiifna.

english: What Would You Like Help With?
Your offer is with the patient
Your offer was accepted. Appointment details show its current status and next steps.
amharic: አቅርቦቱ ተቀብሏል። የቀጠሮ ዝርዝሮች አሁን ያለውን ሁኔታ እና ቀጣይ እርምጃዎች ያሳያሉ።
afaan_oromo: Yaadni fudhatameera. Bal’inni beellamaa haala yeroo ammaa fi tarkaanfii itti aanu agarsiisa.

english: Your offers could not be loaded.
Your preferred name and request text will be shared. Saved history and files stay private until you select a treating clinician.
amharic: የመረጡት ስም እና የጥያቄ ጽሑፍ ይጋራሉ። ባለሙያ እስኪመርጡ ድረስ ታሪክና ፋይሎች የግል ናቸው።
afaan_oromo: Maqaan filattan fi barruun gaaffii keessanii ni qoodamu. Seenaa fi faayiloonni hanga ogeessa filattanitti dhuunfaa ta’u.

english: Your quote is private. The patient selects an offer and completes the applicable payment and booking approvals.
Your request is saved, but no clinicians currently meet every selected requirement. Keep waiting or browse available clinicians.
Your request is saved. We’ll show offers here when eligible clinicians respond. An enqueued notice does not confirm that it was seen.
Your request text is visible to its recipients even when your name is not shared. Avoid names and details that identify you.
amharic: ስምዎ ባይጋራም የጥያቄዎ ጽሑፍ ለተቀባዮቹ ይታያል። የሚለዩዎትን ስሞች እና ዝርዝሮች ያስወግዱ።
afaan_oromo: Maqaan keessan yoo hin qoodamnellee barruun gaaffii fudhattootaaf mul’ata. Maqaa fi waan isin beeksisu irraa of qusadhaa.

english: Care options could not be loaded.
Review what you share, the final price and the booking policy before confirming.
This service is no longer available.
This service is not an emergency response service.
Understand the service before choosing a time.
Choose a duration from 5 to 240 minutes.
amharic: ከ5 እስከ240 ደቂቃ የሚቆይ ጊዜ ይምረጡ።

english: Create an offering after its service scope is approved.
amharic: የሙያ ፈቃድ ከተሰጠ በኋላ አገልግሎት ያዘጋጁ።
afaan_oromo: Daangaan tajaajilaa erga hayyamamee booda tajaajila uumi.

english: Create tailored offerings within your approved scopes.
amharic: በተፈቀዱ የሙያ ወሰኖች ውስጥ አገልግሎቶችን ያዘጋጁ።
afaan_oromo: Daangaa hayyamame keessatti tajaajiloota kee qopheessi.

english: Each service needs its own human approval before publication.
amharic: እያንዳንዱ አገልግሎት ከመታተሙ በፊት በሰው ፈቃድ ይፈልጋል።
afaan_oromo: Tajaajilli hundi maxxanfamuu dura hayyama namaa adda isaa barbaada.

english: Enter a positive amount with at most two decimal places.
amharic: አዎንታዊ መጠን እስከ ሁለት አስርዮሽ ቦታዎች ያስገቡ።
afaan_oromo: Hanga zeeroo ol ta'e lakkoofsa kudhan keessaa bakka lama qofa qabu galchi.

english: Format, confirmation and booking rules come from your availability schedule. Saving an offering does not publish available times.
amharic: የምክክር አይነት፣ ማረጋገጫና የቀጠሮ ሕጎች ከጊዜ ሰሌዳዎ ይመጣሉ። አገልግሎት ማስቀመጥ የሥራ ጊዜን አያትምም።
afaan_oromo: Bifti marii, mirkaneessiifi seerri beellamaa sagantaa saʼaatii keetirraa dhufu. Tajaajila kuusuun saʼaatii banaa hin maxxansu.

english: Offering saved. Publish availability to make it bookable.
amharic: አገልግሎቱ ተቀምጧል። ቀጠሮ እንዲያዝ የጊዜ ሰሌዳን ያትሙ።
afaan_oromo: Tajaajilli kuufameera. Beellamaaf saʼaatii banaa maxxansi.

english: Patients should know exactly what they are booking.
amharic: ታካሚዎች በትክክል ምን እንደሚያዙ ማወቅ አለባቸው።
afaan_oromo: Dhukkubsattoonni maal akka beellaman sirriitti beekuu qabu.

english: Your offerings could not be loaded.
A calendar that works with you
A clinic affiliation does not grant access to patient records.
amharic: ከክሊኒክ ጋር መገናኘት የታካሚ መዝገቦችን ለማየት ፈቃድ አይሰጥም።
afaan_oromo: Kilinika waliin hidhamuun galmee dhukkubsataa argachuuf hayyama hin kennu.

english: A defined session length and a clear price before you book. Extensions need your agreement.
amharic: ከመያዝዎ በፊት የተወሰነ ቆይታ እና ግልጽ ዋጋ። ማራዘሚያዎች ስምምነትዎን ይፈልጋሉ።
afaan_oromo: Turtii murtaa'e fi gatii ifaa beellama dura. Dabalataan waliigaltee kee barbaada.

english: A few words about the support you’re seeking
A link is created only after both adults accept.
amharic: ሁለቱም ጎልማሶች ከተቀበሉ በኋላ ብቻ አገናኝ ይፈጠራል።
afaan_oromo: Namoonni ga'eessonni lamaan erga fudhatanii booda qofa hidhamiinsi uumama.

english: A mandatory assessment has not passed. Request information or decline; scores cannot replace required evidence.
amharic: አስፈላጊ መስፈርት አልተሟላም። መረጃ ይጠይቁ ወይም ውድቅ ያድርጉ፤ ነጥቦች አስፈላጊ ማስረጃን አይተኩም።
afaan_oromo: Madaalliin dirqamaa hin darbine. Odeeffannoo gaafadhu ykn didi; qabxiin ragaa barbaachisaa hin bakka bu'u.

english: A new time is waiting for your response.
afaan_oromo: Yeroon haaraan deebii kee eeggachaa jira.

english: A new time takes effect only when both adults and the clinician agree.
amharic: አዲሱ ሰዓት ሁለቱም አዋቂዎች እና ባለሙያው ሲስማሙ ብቻ ይፀናል።
afaan_oromo: Yeroon haaraan ga'eessonni lamaan fi ogeessi yoo walii galan qofa hojii irra oola.

english: A new time takes effect only when both sides agree.
amharic: አዲሱ ሰዓት ሁለቱም ወገኖች ሲስማሙ ብቻ ይፀናል።
afaan_oromo: Yeroon haaraan gama lachuu yoo walii gale qofa hojii irra oola.

english: A preferred name or alias is enough. You choose whether to share it when you book.
amharic: የሚመርጡት ስም ወይም ቅጽል በቂ ነው። ቀጠሮ ሲያስይዙ ማጋራት ይምረጡ።
afaan_oromo: Maqaan filatamaa ykn maqaan biraa gahaa dha. Yeroo beellama qabattu qooduu isaa filatta.

english: A private request. Clear progress. Your choice.
amharic: የግል ጥያቄ። ግልጽ እድገት። የእርስዎ ምርጫ።
afaan_oromo: Gaaffii dhuunfaa. Adeemsa ifaa. Filannoo kee.

english: A public photo is visible only while your clinician profile is eligible for discovery.
amharic: ይፋዊ ፎቶ የባለሙያ መገለጫዎ ለፍለጋ ብቁ ሲሆን ብቻ ይታያል።
afaan_oromo: Suuraan uummataa yeroo piroofaayiliin ogeessaa kee barbaachaaf ulaagaa guutu qofa mul’ata.

english: A record of how this amount changed your balance.
amharic: ይህ መጠን ቀሪ ሂሳብዎን እንዴት እንደቀየረ መዝገብ።
afaan_oromo: Galmeen kun hammi kun baalansii kee akkamitti akka jijjiire agarsiisa.

english: A relationship link shares no appointments, health history, notes, balances, or call access. Each person must agree separately. Couple and family appointments are not available yet.
amharic: የግንኙነት አገናኝ ቀጠሮ፣ የጤና ታሪክ፣ ማስታወሻ፣ ቀሪ ሂሳብ ወይም የጥሪ መዳረሻ አያጋራም። እያንዳንዱ ሰው በተለይ መስማማት አለበት። የጥንዶችና የቤተሰብ ቀጠሮዎች ገና አይገኙም።
afaan_oromo: Geessituun kun beellama, seenaa fayyaa, yaadannoo, baalansii ykn seensa bilbila hin qoodu. Namni hundi addaan walii galuu qaba. Beellamni hiriyootaa fi maatii ammaaf hin jiru.

english: A renewal request does not extend an expired approval. If the credential has expired, this service remains unavailable until a reviewer records a new approval.
amharic: የማደሻ ጥያቄ ጊዜው ያለፈ ፈቃድን አያራዝምም። ማረጋገጫው ጊዜው ካለፈ፣ ገምጋሚ አዲስ ፈቃድ እስኪመዘግብ ድረስ ይህ አገልግሎት አይገኝም።
afaan_oromo: Gaaffiin haaromsaa hayyama yeroon isaa darbe hin dheeressu. Ragaan yeroon isaa yoo darbe, madaalaan hayyama haaraa galmeessutti tajaajilli kun hin argamu.

english: A reviewer checks registration details. Do not include patient information.
amharic: ገምጋሚ የምዝገባ ዝርዝሮችን ይመረምራል። የታካሚ መረጃ አያካትቱ።
afaan_oromo: Gamaaggamaan odeeffannoo galmee ni mirkaneessa. Odeeffannoo dhukkubsataa hin galchin.

english: A reviewer controls this service setting. It does not replace clinician approval, approved scope, language, presence, or available time.
amharic: ይህን የአገልግሎት ቅንብር ገምጋሚ ይቆጣጠራል። የሐኪም ማጽደቅን፣ የተፈቀደ ወሰንን፣ ቋንቋን፣ ዝግጁነትን ወይም ነፃ ጊዜን አይተካም።
afaan_oromo: Gamaaggamaan qindaa'ina tajaajila kana to'ata. Mirkaneessa ogeessaa, daangaa hayyamame, afaan, qophii ykn yeroo bilisaa hin bakka bu'u.

english: A reviewer must enable immediate requests for this service. Service-scope approval alone does not enable this. This does not guarantee a request or match.
amharic: ለዚህ አገልግሎት ፈጣን ጥያቄዎችን ገምጋሚ ማንቃት አለበት። የአገልግሎት ወሰን ማጽደቅ ብቻውን ይህን አያነቃም። ጥያቄ ወይም ግጥሚያ እንደሚመጣ ዋስትና አይሰጥም።
afaan_oromo: Gamaaggamaan gaaffiiwwan ariifachiisoo tajaajila kanaaf banuu qaba. Mirkaneessi daangaa tajaajilaa qofti kana hin banu. Gaaffii ykn walitti dhufeenya hin mirkaneessu.

english: A reviewer must enable immediate requests for this service. This does not guarantee a request or match.
amharic: ለዚህ አገልግሎት ፈጣን ጥያቄዎችን ገምጋሚ ማንቃት አለበት። ይህ ጥያቄ ወይም ግጥሚያ እንደሚመጣ ዋስትና አይሰጥም።
afaan_oromo: Gamaaggamaan tajaajila kanaaf gaaffiiwwan ariifachiisoo banuu qaba. Kun gaaffii ykn walitti dhufeenya mirkaneessu miti.

english: A selected file is too large. Check the size limit and try again.
amharic: የተመረጠው ፋይል በጣም ትልቅ ነው። የመጠን ገደቡን ያረጋግጡና ይሞክሩ።
afaan_oromo: Faayiliin filatame guddaa dha. Daangaa hammamtaa ilaaliitii irra deebiʼi yaali.

english: A structured catalog of services, separate from clinician-specific offerings.
amharic: የተዋቀረ የአገልግሎቶች ዝርዝር፣ ከባለሙያዎች የግል አቅርቦቶች የተለየ።
afaan_oromo: Tarree tajaajiloota caaseffame, dhiyeessii ogeessa dhuunfaa irraa adda ta'e.

english: Accept only if you recognize this clinic and want this operational role. You can withdraw access later or ask a clinic manager to revoke it.
amharic: ክሊኒኩን ካወቁና ይህን ሚና ከፈለጉ ብቻ ይቀበሉ። በኋላ መውጣት ወይም ሥራ አስኪያጁ መዳረሻን እንዲሰርዝ መጠየቅ ይችላሉ።
afaan_oromo: Kilinika kana yoo beekteefi gahee kana yoo barbaadde qofa fudhadhu. Booda bahuu ykn bulchaan akka haqamu gaafachuu dandeessa.

english: Accepted, expired, withdrawn and unselected offers.
amharic: የተቀበሉ፣ ጊዜያቸው ያለፈ፣ የተመለሱ እና ያልተመረጡ አቅርቦቶች።
afaan_oromo: Dhiyeessii fudhataman, yeroon darbe, haqaman fi hin filatamne.

english: Accepted offers and your consultation links.
afaan_oromo: Dhiyeessii fudhataman fi hidhannoo marii kee.

english: Accepting links your patient accounts for future shared-care features. It does not share appointments, history, notes, balances, or calls.
amharic: መቀበል ለወደፊት የጋራ እንክብካቤ ብቻ መለያዎችን ያገናኛል። ቀጠሮ፣ ታሪክ፣ ማስታወሻ፣ ቀሪ ሂሳብ ወይም ጥሪ አያጋራም።
afaan_oromo: Fudhachuun herrega keessan tajaajila waliin kunuunsuuf qofa walitti hidha. Beellama, seenaa, yaadannoo, baalansii ykn bilbila hin qoodu.

english: Add a PDF resume. Receipt does not mean your credentials are verified.
amharic: የPDF የስራ ልምድ ሰነድ ያክሉ። መቀበሉ ምስክርነትዎ ተረጋግጧል ማለት አይደለም።

afaan_oromo: Qabxii galchite tokkoon tokkoof sababaa ibsi. Murtii galmeessuu dura qabxii hin xumuramne xumuri ykn qulqulleessi.

english: Add funds before confirming. This time is not held yet.
amharic: ከማረጋገጥዎ በፊት ገንዘብ ይጨምሩ። ይህ ሰዓት ገና አልተያዘም።
afaan_oromo: Mirkaneessuu dura maallaqa dabali. Yeroon kun ammaaf hin qabamne.

english: Add funds in a new tab
Add your professional category, qualification and issuing institution before submission.
amharic: ከማስገባትዎ በፊት የሙያ ዘርፍዎን፣ ብቃትዎንና የሰጠውን ተቋም ይሙሉ።
afaan_oromo: Erguu dura gosa ogummaa, barnootaa fi dhaabbata kenne guuti.

amharic: ለ18 ዓመት እና ከዚያ በላይ · የአስቸኳይ ጊዜ አገልግሎት አይደለም።

english: Affiliation is separate from clinical approval
amharic: የክሊኒክ ትስስር ከክሊኒካዊ ፈቃድ የተለየ ነው
afaan_oromo: Hidhanni kilinikaa hayyama yaalaa irraa adda

english: After both adults agree, authorize the reservation from your balance.
amharic: ሁለቱም ከተስማሙ በኋላ ከሂሳብዎ ማስያዙን ያጽድቁ።
afaan_oromo: Ga’eessonni lamaan erga walii galanii booda baalansii keetirraa maallaqa qabsiisuu hayyami.

english: After you publish, eligible clinicians receive this request and selected identity. Saved history and files remain private.
amharic: ከላኩ በኋላ ብቁ ባለሙያዎች ጥያቄውንና የመረጡትን ማንነት ያያሉ። የተቀመጠ ታሪክና ፋይሎች የግል ይቀራሉ።
afaan_oromo: Erga maxxansitee booda ogeessonni ulaagaalee guutan gaaffii fi eenyummaa filatte argatu. Seenaa fi faayiloonni kuufaman dhuunfaa taʼanii turu.
Dura hayyamamteetta? Iddoo hojii kee ilaali

english: An appointment is confirmed only after acceptance and funds reservation.
amharic: ቀጠሮው የሚረጋገጠው ከመቀበልና ገንዘብ ከመያዝ በኋላ ብቻ ነው።
afaan_oromo: Beellamni fudhatamuu fi maallaqa qabamuu booda qofa mirkanaaʼa.

english: An approach is no longer available. In Relevant experience, move the unlisted entry to your training description before saving.
amharic: ዘዴው አሁን አይገኝም። በልምድ ደረጃው ከማስቀመጥዎ በፊት ያልተዘረዘረውን ወደ ስልጠና መግለጫ ያንቀሳቅሱ።
afaan_oromo: Malli kun amma hin jiru. Tarkaanfii muuxannoo keessatti olkaa'uu dura galtee hin tarreeffamne gara ibsa leenjii geessi.

english: An enqueued notification or inbox fetch does not prove that a clinician read the request. These demonstration results are not pilot performance or a guaranteed response time.
amharic: ማሳወቂያ መሰለፉ ወይም ጥያቄ መጫኑ ባለሙያው ጥያቄውን ማንበቡን አያረጋግጥም። እነዚህ የማሳያ ውጤቶች የሙከራ አፈጻጸም ወይም የተረጋገጠ የምላሽ ጊዜ አይደሉም።
afaan_oromo: Beeksisni tarree keessa galuu ykn gaaffiin fe’amuu ogeessi dubbisuu isaa hin mirkaneessu. Bu’aan agarsiisaa kun raawwii yaalii ykn yeroo deebii wabii qabu miti.

english: Anything you’d like your clinician to know?
afaan_oromo: Wanti ogeessi kee akka beeku barbaaddu jiraa?

english: Application review, private evidence, credential checks, scope decisions and correction workflows.
amharic: የማመልከቻ ግምገማ፣ የግል ማስረጃ፣ ማረጋገጫ፣ ውሳኔና እርማት ሂደቶች።
afaan_oromo: Gamaaggama iyyataa, ragaa dhuunfaa, mirkaneessa, murtii fi adeemsa sirreeffamaa.

english: Applications are reviewed by a person. Approval is granted separately for each requested service scope.
amharic: ማመልከቻዎች በሰው ይገመገማሉ። እያንዳንዱ የተጠየቀ ወሰን በተለየ ይፈቀዳል።
afaan_oromo: Iyyannoon namaan gamaaggamama. Daangaan tajaajilaa gaafate hundi adda addaan hayyamama.

english: Apply for each service and submit private qualifications for individual review. Public profile edits do not grant service approval.
amharic: ለእያንዳንዱ አገልግሎት ያመልክቱ እና የግል የብቃት ማስረጃዎችን ለተናጠል ግምገማ ያቅርቡ። የሕዝብ መገለጫ ለውጥ የአገልግሎት ፈቃድ አይሰጥም።
afaan_oromo: Tajaajila hundaaf iyyadhuutii gahumsa dhuunfaa gamaaggama adda addaatiif dhiyeessi. Gulaalliin seenaa uummataa hayyama tajaajilaa hin kennu.

english: Apply for each service separately. Clinic affiliations do not establish competence, and approval is always decided by a human reviewer.
amharic: ለእያንዳንዱ አገልግሎት በተለይ ያመልክቱ። ከክሊኒክ ጋር መገናኘት ብቃትን አያረጋግጥም፤ ውሳኔውን ሰው ገምጋሚ ይሰጣል።
afaan_oromo: Tajaajila tokkoon tokkoon isaaf addaan iyyadhu. Walitti dhufeenyi kilinikaa dandeettii hin mirkaneessu; murtiin gamaaggamaa namaatiin kennama.

english: Apply for each service separately. General application status does not approve a service.
amharic: ለእያንዳንዱ አገልግሎት ለብቻው ያመልክቱ። አጠቃላይ የማመልከቻ ሁኔታ አገልግሎትን አያጸድቅም።
afaan_oromo: Tajaajila tokkoon tokkoof addaan iyyadhu. Haalli iyyataa waliigalaa tajaajila hin hayyamu.

english: Apply, verify your expertise, and set up your practice.
amharic: ያመልክቱ፣ ብቃትዎን ለግምገማ ያቅርቡ እና ስራዎን ያዘጋጁ።
afaan_oromo: Iyyadhu, ogummaa kee ilaalchiisi, hojii kee qopheessi.

english: Apply with your professional profile and private supporting evidence.
afaan_oromo: Seenaa ogummaa fi ragaa dhuunfaatiin iyyadhaa.

english: Appointment status could not be refreshed.

amharic: የቀጠሮ ጊዜ ለውጥ ጥያቄ ጊዜ አልፎበታል

english: Appointment times also show the timezone saved with each booking.
amharic: የቀጠሮ ሰዓቶች ከእያንዳንዱ ቀጠሮ ጋር የተቀመጠውን የሰዓት ክልል ያሳያሉ።
afaan_oromo: Sa'aatiin beellamaa naannoo sa'aatii beellama sana waliin olkaa'ame agarsiisa.

english: Appointment updates could not be refreshed.
Appointment updates could not be refreshed. Accepted offers remain available.
amharic: የቀጠሮ መረጃ አልታደሰም። የተቀበሉ ቅናሾች አሁንም ይገኛሉ።
afaan_oromo: Odeeffannoon beellamaa hin haaromfamne. Yaadonni fudhataman ammallee ni jiru.

english: Appointments appear here only when a patient has shared their schedule with this verified clinic.
amharic: ታካሚው የቀጠሮ መረጃውን ለዚህ የተረጋገጠ ክሊኒክ ሲያጋራ ብቻ ቀጠሮዎች እዚህ ይታያሉ።
afaan_oromo: Beellamni kan mul'atu dhukkubsataan sagantaa isaa kilinikaa mirkanaa'e kanaaf yeroo qoodu qofa.

english: Appointments appear only after a patient shares a future booking with this clinic.
amharic: ታካሚው ወደፊት ያለውን ቀጠሮ ለዚህ ክሊኒክ ካጋራ በኋላ ብቻ ይታያል።
afaan_oromo: Beellamni gara fuulduraa dhukkubsataan kilinikaa kanaaf qoodu qofa asitti mul'ata.

english: Appointments, follow-ups and updates for your account.
afaan_oromo: Beellamoota, hordoffii fi odeeffannoo herrega keessanii.

english: Approval and each service scope are reviewed by an administrator. Resume files are private application evidence; upload does not verify credentials.
amharic: ፈቃድና እያንዳንዱ የአገልግሎት ወሰን በአስተዳዳሪ ይገመገማሉ። የሥራ ልምድ ፋይሎች የግል ማስረጃ ናቸው፤ መስቀል ብቃትን አያረጋግጥም።
afaan_oromo: Hayyamni fi daangaan tajaajilaa hundi bulchaan ilaalama. Faayiloonni CV ragaa iyyannoo dhuunfaa ti; ol fe'uun ragaa ogummaa hin mirkaneessu.

english: Approval is manual and does not automatically approve requested services.
amharic: ማጽደቅ በእጅ ይከናወናል፤ የተጠየቁ አገልግሎቶችን በራስ-ሰር አያጸድቅም።
afaan_oromo: Mirkaneessi harkaan raawwatama; tajaajiloota gaafataman ofumaan hin mirkaneessu.

english: Approval, language and format determine eligible services. Open times are checked before booking.
amharic: ፈቃድ፣ ቋንቋና የምክክር ዘዴ ብቁ አገልግሎቶችን ይወስናሉ። ክፍት ጊዜዎች ከቦታ ማስያዝ በፊት ይፈተሻሉ።
afaan_oromo: Hayyamni, afaanii fi bifa marii tajaajila mijataa murteessu. Yeroon banaan qabsiisuu dura sakatta’ama.

english: Approval needs a license document attached to this scope, a verification source, check date and source reference. Request information if the document is missing.
amharic: ለማጽደቅ ከዚህ ማመልከቻ ጋር የተያያዘ የፈቃድ ሰነድ፣ ምንጭ፣ የማረጋገጫ ቀንና ማጣቀሻ ያስፈልጋሉ። ሰነዱ ከጎደለ መረጃ ይጠይቁ።
afaan_oromo: Hayyamaaf galmee hayyamaa iyyata kanatti maxxane, madda mirkaneessaa, guyyaa sakatta'iinsaa fi wabii barbaachisa. Galmeen yoo dhabame odeeffannoo gaafadhu.

english: Approve only when all required checks and evidence pass. Request information to let the applicant correct missing documents; decline when requirements are not met.
amharic: አስፈላጊ መስፈርቶችና ማስረጃዎች ሲሟሉ ብቻ ያጽድቁ። ሰነዶች ከጎደሉ መረጃ ይጠይቁ፤ መስፈርቶች ካልተሟሉ ውድቅ ያድርጉ።
afaan_oromo: Sakatta’iinsaa fi ragaan dirqamaa yoo guutaman qofa hayyami. Galmeen yoo dhabame odeeffannoo gaafadhu; ulaagaan yoo hin guutamne didi.

english: Approve only when the evidence and requirements pass. Request information when evidence is missing: clear unfinished verification, choose Request information and state what is needed. The applicant can then edit, upload documents and resubmit. Reject with a meaningful reason when requirements are not met.
amharic: ማስረጃና መስፈርቶች ሲሟሉ ብቻ ያጽድቁ። ማስረጃ ከጎደለ ያልተጠናቀቀውን ማረጋገጫ አጽድተው መረጃ ይጠይቁና የሚያስፈልገውን ይግለጹ። አመልካቹ ማስተካከል፣ ሰነድ መጫንና እንደገና ማስገባት ይችላል። መስፈርቶች ካልተሟሉ ግልጽ ምክንያት ሰጥተው ውድቅ ያድርጉ።
afaan_oromo: Ragaa fi ulaagaan yoo darban qofa hayyami. Ragaan yoo dhabame sakatta’iinsa hin xumuramne qulqulleessii odeeffannoo gaafadhu; waan barbaachisu ibsi. Iyyataan sirreessuu, galmee olkaa’uu fi deebi’ee erguu danda’a. Ulaagaan yoo hin guutamne sababaa ifaan didi.

english: Approved production policy content is pending review. This page does not claim legal approval or compliance.
amharic: ለእውነተኛ አገልግሎት የፖሊሲ ይዘት ግምገማ ይጠብቃል። ይህ ገጽ ሕጋዊ ፈቃድን አያረጋግጥም።
afaan_oromo: Qabiyyeen imaammataa tajaajila dhugaaf gamaaggama eega. Fuulli kun hayyama seeraa hin mirkaneessu.

english: Approved services could not be loaded.
Ask a reviewer to enable immediate requests for a service
amharic: ገምጋሚውን ለአገልግሎት ፈጣን ጥያቄዎችን እንዲያነቃ ይጠይቁ
afaan_oromo: Gamaaggamaa tajaajilaaf gaaffii ariifataa akka banu gaafadhu

english: At least 20 characters. Record service-level reasoning; do not include patient data. This is retained in the review history.
amharic: ቢያንስ 20 ቁምፊዎች። የአገልግሎት ምክንያትን ይመዝግቡ፤ የታካሚ መረጃ አያካትቱ። በግምገማ ታሪክ ይቀመጣል።
afaan_oromo: Yoo xiqqaate qubee 20. Sababa tajaajilaa galmeessi; odeeffannoo dhukkubsataa hin galchin. Seenaa gamaaggamaa keessatti ni turu.

english: At least 20 characters. This is retained in the review history.
amharic: ቢያንስ 20 ቁምፊዎች። ይህ በግምገማ ታሪክ ውስጥ ይቀመጣል።
afaan_oromo: Yoo xiqqaate arfama 20. Kun seenaa gamaaggamaa keessatti ni turu.

english: Audio-only is available if video is unstable.
amharic: ቪዲዮው ካልተረጋጋ በድምፅ ብቻ መቀጠል ይቻላል።
afaan_oromo: Viidiyoon yoo hin tasgabboofne sagalee qofaan itti fufi.

english: Automatic availability resumes during your published hours while this workspace is connected.
amharic: ይህ የሥራ ገጽ ሲገናኝ በታተሙ ሰዓቶች ራስ ሰር ዝግጁነት ይቀጥላል።

english: Automatic during published hours · Manual pause always takes priority.

afaan_oromo: Sa’aatii maxxanfame keessatti ofumaan · Harkaan dhaabuun dursa qaba.

afaan_oromo: Odeeffannoon yeroo hin haaromfamne. Haalli duraan mulʼate dulloomuu dandaʼa.

english: Availability is checked every 30 seconds and again before booking.
amharic: የጊዜ መረጃ በየ30 ሰከንድ እና ከቀጠሮ በፊት ይረጋገጣል።

afaan_oromo: Yeroo jiru mirkaneessuun hin danda'amne. Calala kana haqii irra deebi'ii yaali.

english: Available times could not be loaded.
Become available during these published hours while your workspace is connected. You can pause from Today at any time.
amharic: የሥራ ገጽዎ ሲገናኝ በእነዚህ የታተሙ ሰዓቶች ዝግጁ ይሁኑ። ከዛሬ ገጽ በማንኛውም ጊዜ ማቆም ይችላሉ።

english: Book a suitable time or ask eligible clinicians for a private offer.
amharic: ተስማሚ ጊዜ ያስይዙ ወይም ብቁ ባለሙያዎችን የግል አቅርቦት ይጠይቁ።
afaan_oromo: Yeroo mijataa qabadhaa ykn ogeessota ulaagaa guutan yaada dhuunfaa gaafadhaa.

english: Booked duration is not measured connected time.
amharic: የተያዘው የቆይታ ጊዜ የተለካ የግንኙነት ጊዜ አይደለም።
afaan_oromo: Yeroon beellamaa yeroo walqunnamtii safarame miti.

english: Booking updates use verified contacts and your delivery preferences. Provider availability still applies.
amharic: የቀጠሮ ዝማኔዎች የተረጋገጡ አድራሻዎችን እና የመላኪያ ምርጫዎችዎን ይጠቀማሉ። የአቅራቢው ተገኝነት ያስፈልጋል።

english: Bring your patients, publish approved services, manage bookings, and respond to people looking for your expertise.
amharic: ታካሚዎችዎን ያምጡ፣ የተፈቀዱ አገልግሎቶችን ያትሙ፣ ቀጠሮዎችን ያስተዳድሩ፣ እውቀትዎን ለሚፈልጉ ሰዎች ይመልሱ።
afaan_oromo: Fayyadamtoota kee fidi, tajaajila hayyamame maxxansi, beellama bulchi, namoota ogummaa kee barbaadaniif deebisi.

english: Bring your patients, publish your availability and manage consultations in one place.
amharic: ታካሚዎችዎን ያገናኙ፣ የሚገኙበትን ሰዓት ያሳውቁ፣ ምክክሮችን በአንድ ቦታ ያስተዳድሩ።
afaan_oromo: Dhukkubsattoota keessan walitti fidaa, yeroo keessan maxxansaa, marii bakka tokkotti bulchaa.

english: Bring your patients, publish your availability, and meet people looking for your expertise.
amharic: ታካሚዎችዎን ያምጡ፣ የሚገኙበትን ጊዜ ያሳውቁ፣ ሙያዎን ከሚፈልጉ ሰዎች ጋር ይገናኙ።
afaan_oromo: Dhukkubsattoota kee fidi, yeroo argamtu maxxansi, namoota ogummaa kee barbaadan waliin wal argi.

english: Browse approved clinicians and services. Filters update results immediately.
amharic: የተፈቀዱ ባለሙያዎችንና አገልግሎቶችን ይመልከቱ። ማጣሪያዎች ውጤቶችን ወዲያውኑ ያድሳሉ።
afaan_oromo: Ogeessotaa fi tajaajiloota hayyamaman ilaali. Calaltuun buʼaa battalumatti haaromsa.

english: Browse clinicians and services, or post a private request.
amharic: ባለሙያዎችንና አገልግሎቶችን ይመልከቱ፣ ወይም የግል ጥያቄ ይላኩ።

english: Browse mental-health and counseling services, choose a clinician and book a time—or request an available expert.
amharic: የአእምሮ ጤናና የምክር አገልግሎቶችን ያስሱ፣ ባለሙያና ሰዓት ይምረጡ፤ ወይም የሚገኝ ባለሙያ ይጠይቁ።

english: Browse services, languages, session formats and published prices.
amharic: አገልግሎቶችን፣ ቋንቋዎችን፣ የክፍለ ጊዜ አይነትና ዋጋን ያስሱ።
afaan_oromo: Tajaajila, afaan, bifa marii fi gatii maxxanfame ilaalaa.

english: Can I browse before creating an account?
Can I publish services as soon as I apply?
Can I set my own schedule?
Cancel before the session starts to release the full reservation.
amharic: የተያዘውን ሙሉ ገንዘብ ለመመለስ ክፍለ ጊዜው ከመጀመሩ በፊት ይሰርዙ።
afaan_oromo: Maallaqa qabame hunda deebisuuf mariin jalqabuu dura haqi.

english: Change a filter or post a request. Your preferences will not be broadened automatically.
amharic: ማጣሪያ ይቀይሩ ወይም ጥያቄ ይላኩ። ምርጫዎችዎ በራሳቸው አይለወጡም።

amharic: ከመወሰንዎ በፊት ቀጠሮውን፣ ጠቅላላ ዋጋውን እና የማጋራት ምርጫዎን ይመልከቱ።
afaan_oromo: Murtii dura beellama, gatii waliigalaa fi filannoo qooduu kee ilaali.

english: Check the issuing authority yourself. Record the source, actual check date, source reference and uploaded license document. A source reference identifies the registry record or your documented check; it is not a password. Do not mark a credential verified merely because a file was uploaded.
amharic: ሰጪውን ባለሥልጣን በራስዎ ያረጋግጡ። ምንጩን፣ ትክክለኛ የማረጋገጫ ቀንን፣ የምንጭ ማጣቀሻንና የተጫነውን የፈቃድ ሰነድ ይመዝግቡ። ማጣቀሻው የምዝገባ መዝገብ ወይም የማረጋገጫ መዝገብ ነው፤ የይለፍ ቃል አይደለም። ሰነድ መጫን ብቻ ማረጋገጥ አይደለም።
afaan_oromo: Qaama ragaa kenne ofii keetiin sakatta’i. Madda, guyyaa sakatta’iinsaa dhugaa, wabii fi galmee hayyamaa galmeessi. Wabiin galmee kuusaa ykn sakatta’iinsa kee adda baasa; jecha iccitii miti. Galmeen olkaa’amuu qofti mirkaneessa miti.

english: Check the time, price and sharing choices before accepting.
amharic: ከመቀበልዎ በፊት ጊዜን፣ ዋጋንና የማጋሪያ ምርጫዎችን ይመልከቱ።
afaan_oromo: Fudhachuu dura yeroo, gatii fi filannoo qoodinsa ilaali.

english: Checking open times in the next 14 days…
amharic: በሚቀጥሉት 14 ቀናት ያሉ ክፍት ሰዓቶችን በመፈተሽ ላይ…
afaan_oromo: Yeroo banaa guyyoota 14 dhufan keessa jiran ilaalaa…

english: Choose a duration from 5 to 240 minutes.
amharic: ከ5 እስከ240 ደቂቃ የሚቆይ ጊዜ ይምረጡ።

english: Choose a License or registration document uploaded to this service application.
amharic: ወደዚህ ማመልከቻ የተጫነ የፈቃድ ወይም ምዝገባ ሰነድ ይምረጡ።

Choose a time to add a weekly interval.
Choose a time to prepare a date-specific replacement. Confirm it in Date exceptions before saving. Existing appointments remain unchanged.

english: Choose a valid image up to 3 MB.
amharic: እስከ 3 MB የሆነ ትክክለኛ ምስል ይምረጡ።

english: Choose a valid, non-animated JPEG, PNG or WebP image up to 3 MB and 4096 pixels.
amharic: የማይንቀሳቀስ JPEG፣ PNG ወይም WebP እስከ 3 MB እና 4096 ፒክስል ይምረጡ።
afaan_oromo: Suuraa hin sochoone JPEG, PNG ykn WebP hanga 3 MB fi piikselii 4096 filadhaa.

english: Choose a valid PDF, JPEG or PNG up to 5 MB. PDFs must be unencrypted and non-interactive.
amharic: ትክክለኛ PDF፣ JPEG ወይም PNG እስከ 5 MB ይምረጡ። PDF ያልተመሰጠረና የማይገናኝ መሆን አለበት።
afaan_oromo: PDF, JPEG ykn PNG sirrii hanga 5 MB filadhu. PDF icciitiin hin cufamneefi hojii walqunnamtii hin qabne taʼuu qaba.

english: Choose an amount within your available earnings.
afaan_oromo: Hanga galii kee argamu keessaa filadhu.

english: Choose an approved offering, then invite the other adult to make their own choices.
amharic: የተፈቀደ አገልግሎት ይምረጡ፣ ከዚያ ሌላው ጎልማሳ የራሱን ምርጫ እንዲያደርግ ይጋብዙ።
afaan_oromo: Tajaajila hayyamame filadhu; achiis ga'eessa biraa filannoo isaa akka godhu affeeri.

english: Choose an offer to review its outcome.
afaan_oromo: Bu’aa isaa ilaaluuf yaada dhiyaate filadhaa.

english: Choose an outcome and record the reviewer rationale.
Choose another area of your workspace.
Choose another view to find your conversations.
afaan_oromo: Mariilee kee argachuuf ilaalcha biraa filadhu.

english: Choose at least one consultation language.
afaan_oromo: Afaan marii tokko yoo xiqqaate filadhu.

english: Choose at least one service for review.
afaan_oromo: Gamaaggamaaf tajaajila tokko yoo xiqqaate filadhu.

english: Choose files for this treating clinician only. Nothing is shared until you confirm this booking.
amharic: ለዚህ ባለሙያ ብቻ ፋይሎችን ይምረጡ። ቀጠሮውን እስኪያረጋግጡ ምንም አይጋራም።
afaan_oromo: Faayiloota ogeessa kanaaf qofa filadhu. Hanga beellama mirkaneessitutti homtuu hin qoodamu.

english: Choose from approved services that fit your selections.
amharic: ከምርጫዎችዎ ጋር የሚስማሙ ከተፈቀዱ አገልግሎቶች ይምረጡ።
afaan_oromo: Tajaajiloota hayyamaman filannoo keef mijatan keessaa filadhu.

english: Choose how appointments can be booked. Consultation, notes and summary requirements belong under Required platform workflows.
amharic: ቀጠሮዎች እንዴት እንደሚያዙ ይምረጡ። የምክክር፣ ማስታወሻና ማጠቃለያ መስፈርቶች በመድረክ የሥራ ሂደቶች ስር ናቸው።
afaan_oromo: Beellamni akkamitti qabamu filadhu. Ulaagaaleen marii, yaadannoo fi cuunfaa adeemsa waltajjii keessatti galmaa’u.

english: Choose how appointments can be booked. These choices do not enable immediate care without its separate review.
amharic: ቀጠሮዎች እንዴት እንደሚያዙ ይምረጡ። እነዚህ ምርጫዎች ያለ ተለየ ግምገማ ፈጣን እንክብካቤን አያነቁም።
afaan_oromo: Beellamni akkamitti qabamu filadhu. Filannoowwan kun gamaaggama addaatiin alatti kunuunsa hatattamaa hin banan.

english: Choose license evidence attached to this service application.
amharic: ከዚህ የአገልግሎት ማመልከቻ ጋር የተያያዘውን የፈቃድ ማስረጃ ይምረጡ።
afaan_oromo: Ragaa hayyamaa iyyannoo tajaajila kanaatti maxxanfame filadhu.

english: Choose one file for this upload.
afaan_oromo: Ol feʼuu kanaaf faayilii tokko filadhu.

english: Choose the amount you need for your appointments.
Choose the person, time, and privacy that feel right for you.
amharic: ለእርስዎ የሚመች ሰው፣ ጊዜ እና ግላዊነት ይምረጡ።
afaan_oromo: Nama, yeroo fi iccitii siif mijatu filadhu.

english: Choose treatment approaches from the reviewed catalog only. Remove any unlisted approach and try again.

afaan_oromo: Mala yaalaa tarree gamaaggamame keessaa qofa filadhu. Mala hin tarreeffamne haqiitii irra deebi'i.

english: Choose what you share, and with whom.
afaan_oromo: Maal akka qooddan fi eenyuuf akka qooddan filadhaa.

english: Choose whether to approve, request information or decline this application.
amharic: ይህን ማመልከቻ ለማጽደቅ፣ መረጃ ለመጠየቅ ወይም ውድቅ ለማድረግ ይምረጡ።
afaan_oromo: Iyyata kana hayyamuu, odeeffannoo gaafachuu ykn diduu filadhu.

english: Choose your clinician and decide how your name, saved history and selected files are shared for an encounter. Private notes and deliberately shared summaries stay distinct.
amharic: ባለሙያዎን ይምረጡ፤ ስም፣ ታሪክና የተመረጡ ፋይሎች እንዴት እንደሚጋሩ ይወስኑ። የግል ማስታወሻና የተጋሩ ማጠቃለያዎች ለየብቻ ናቸው።
afaan_oromo: Ogeessa filadhaa; maqaa, seenaa fi faayiloota akkamitti akka qooddan murteessaa. Yaadannoowwan dhuunfaa fi cuunfaan qoodaman adda ta’u.

english: Choose your clinician, see the fee, and decide what you share. Browse directly or ask eligible clinicians for a private offer.
amharic: ባለሙያዎን ይምረጡ፣ ዋጋውን ይመልከቱ፣ የሚያጋሩትን ይወስኑ። በቀጥታ ይፈልጉ ወይም ከተፈቀደላቸው ባለሙያዎች የግል አቅርቦት ይጠይቁ።
afaan_oromo: Ogeessa filadhu, gatii ilaali, waan qooddu murteessi. Kallattiin barbaadi ykn ogeessota ulaagaa guutan irraa dhiyeessa dhuunfaa gaafadhu.

english: Choose your sharing defaults. You can change these for each booking.
amharic: ነባሪ የማጋራት ምርጫዎን ይምረጡ። ለእያንዳንዱ ቀጠሮ መቀየር ይችላሉ።
afaan_oromo: Filannoo qoodinsaa keessan filadhaa. Beellama hundaaf jijjiiruu dandeessu.

english: Clear the unfinished credential check before requesting information, or complete it and confirm verification after checking the source.
amharic: መረጃ ከመጠየቅ በፊት ያልተጠናቀቀውን ማረጋገጫ ያጽዱ፤ ወይም ምንጩን ፈትሸው ማረጋገጫውን ያጠናቅቁ።
afaan_oromo: Odeeffannoo gaafachuu dura sakatta'iinsa hin xumuramne qulqulleessi; ykn madda sakatta'uun mirkaneessa xumuri.

english: Clinic access could not be loaded.
Clinic affiliation does not grant access to this record.
amharic: ከክሊኒክ ጋር ትስስር ወደዚህ መዝገብ መዳረሻ አይሰጥም።
afaan_oromo: Hidhanni kilinikaa galmee kana seenuuf hayyama hin kennu.

english: Clinic calendar could not be loaded. Check your clinic access and timezone.
amharic: የክሊኒኩን ቀን መቁጠሪያ መጫን አልተቻለም። የክሊኒክ ፈቃድዎንና የሰዓት ክልሉን ይፈትሹ።
afaan_oromo: Kaalandarii kilinikaa fe'uun hin danda'amne. Hayyama kilinikaa fi naannoo sa'aatii ilaali.

english: Clinic information could not be loaded.
Clinic membership supports operational work only. It does not grant access to patient records or authorize clinical services.
amharic: የክሊኒክ አባልነት ለአስተዳደር ሥራ ብቻ ነው። የታካሚ መዝገብ መዳረሻ ወይም የሕክምና ፈቃድ አይሰጥም።
afaan_oromo: Miseensummaan kilinikaa hojii bulchiinsaa qofaaf. Galmee dhukkubsataa hin banu; tajaajila yaalaas hin hayyamu.

english: Clinic review queue could not be loaded.
amharic: Tarree ggamaggama kilinikaa fe'uun hin danda'amne.
afaan_oromo: Tarree gamaaggama kilinikaa fe'uun hin danda'amne.

english: Clinic team could not be loaded.
Clinical definition review pending. Applying does not authorize bookings.
amharic: የአገልግሎት ትርጉም ግምገማ በመጠባበቅ ላይ ነው። ማመልከት ቀጠሮ ለመቀበል ፈቃድ አይሰጥም።
afaan_oromo: Gamaaggamni hiika tajaajilaa eegamaa jira. Iyyachuun beellama fudhachuuf hayyama hin kennu.

english: Clinician applications are unavailable on this site.
afaan_oromo: Iyyanni ogeessaa marsariitii kana irratti hin banamne.

english: Clinicians apply for each service separately. Upload private documents in Professional review, save the draft, then submit. If information is requested, open the application, correct it and resubmit. Approval is always manual.
amharic: ባለሙያዎች ለእያንዳንዱ አገልግሎት ለየብቻ ያመለክታሉ። በሙያ ግምገማ የግል ሰነዶችን ጫኑ፣ ረቂቁን አስቀምጡና አስገቡ። መረጃ ከተጠየቀ ማመልከቻውን ክፈቱ፣ አስተካክሉና እንደገና አስገቡ። ፈቃድ ሁልጊዜ በሰው ይወሰናል።
afaan_oromo: Ogeessonni tajaajila tokkoon tokkoof addaan iyyatu. Gamaaggama ogummaa keessatti galmee dhuunfaa olkaa’i, wixinee olkaa’iitii ergi. Odeeffannoon yoo gaafatame iyyata bani, sirreessiitii deebi’ii ergi. Hayyamni yeroo hunda namaan murtaa’a.

english: Clinicians will no longer be able to respond. Existing appointments are managed separately.
amharic: ባለሙያዎች ከእንግዲህ ምላሽ መስጠት አይችሉም። ያሉ ቀጠሮዎች በተለየ ይተዳደራሉ።
afaan_oromo: Ogeeyyiin deebii kennuu hin danda’an. Beellamoonni jiran adda bulu.

english: Closed offers preserve your quote and outcome. They do not reveal another clinician’s offer or the patient’s future care.
amharic: የተዘጉ አቅርቦቶች ዋጋዎን እና ውጤቱን ይይዛሉ። የሌላ ባለሙያ አቅርቦት ወይም የታካሚውን ቀጣይ እንክብካቤ አያሳዩም።
afaan_oromo: Dhiyeessiin cufame gatii fi bu’aa kee eega. Dhiyeessii ogeessa biraa ykn kunuunsa dhukkubsataa gara fuulduraa hin mul’isu.

english: Compare private times and prices before choosing.
amharic: ከመምረጥዎ በፊት የግል ሰዓቶችንና ዋጋዎችን ያወዳድሩ።
afaan_oromo: Filachuu dura yeroo fi gatii dhuunfaa wal bira qabi.

english: Compare real offers when they arrive.
Complete every assessment score and rationale before approving this scope.
amharic: ይህን አገልግሎት ከማጽደቅ በፊት ሁሉንም ነጥቦችና ምክንያቶች ይሙሉ።
afaan_oromo: Tajaajila kana hayyamuu dura qabxii fi sababoota madaallii hunda guuti.

english: Complete every score and explain its rationale. Document references beside scores are optional. Mandatory identity, credential, qualification, adult-care, experience and interview checks must pass; high scores cannot compensate for missing requirements.
amharic: እያንዳንዱን ነጥብ ያስገቡና ምክንያቱን ይግለጹ። ከነጥቦች ጎን ያሉ ማጣቀሻዎች አማራጭ ናቸው። የማንነት፣ የፈቃድ፣ የብቃት፣ የአዋቂ እንክብካቤ፣ የልምድና የቃለ መጠይቅ መስፈርቶች መሟላት አለባቸው። ከፍተኛ ነጥብ የጎደለ መስፈርትን አይተካም።
afaan_oromo: Qabxii hunda guutiitii sababaa ibsi. Wabiin ragaa qabxii biratti filannoo dha. Ulaagaaleen eenyummaa, hayyama, barnoota, kunuunsa ga’eessotaa, muuxannoo fi gaaffii dirqamaa darbuu qabu. Qabxiin ol’aanaan ulaagaa dhabame hin bakka bu’u.

english: Complete the steps below or start when you are ready.
amharic: ከታች ያሉትን እርምጃዎች ያጠናቅቁ ወይም ዝግጁ ሲሆኑ ይጀምሩ።
afaan_oromo: Tarkaanfiiwwan armaan gadii xumuraa ykn yeroo qophooftan jalqabaa.

english: Complete your profession, qualification, institution and care languages before submission.
amharic: ከማቅረብዎ በፊት ሙያ፣ ብቃት፣ ተቋምና የእንክብካቤ ቋንቋዎችን ይሙሉ።
afaan_oromo: Dhiyeessuu dura ogummaa, ulaagaa, dhaabbataa fi afaanota kunuunsaa guuti.

english: Complete your professional profile and upload evidence for review. Approval is manual.
amharic: የሙያ መገለጫዎን ያጠናቅቁ እና ለግምገማ ሰነድ ይስቀሉ። ማጽደቅ በእጅ ይከናወናል።
afaan_oromo: Ibsa ogummaa guutiitii ragaa gamaaggamaaf olkaa'i. Mirkaneessi harkaan raawwatama.

english: Confirm or decline this booking. A follow-up email is queued after three minutes without a response.
amharic: ይህን ቀጠሮ ያረጋግጡ ወይም አይቀበሉ። ምላሽ ከሌለ ከሦስት ደቂቃ በኋላ ክትትል ኢሜይል ይዘጋጃል።
afaan_oromo: Beellama kana mirkaneessaa ykn didaa. Deebiin yoo dhabame daqiiqaa sadii booda imeeliin yaadachiisaa qophaa’a.

english: Confirm that your service application is limited to adult care in the Relevant experience step.
amharic: በልምድ ደረጃው ማመልከቻዎ ለአዋቂዎች እንክብካቤ ብቻ መሆኑን ያረጋግጡ።
afaan_oromo: Tarkaanfii muuxannoo keessatti iyyanni kee kunuunsa ga'eessotaa qofaaf ta'uu mirkaneessi.

english: Confirm you are 18 or older before accepting.
amharic: ከመቀበልዎ በፊት 18 ዓመት ወይም ከዚያ በላይ መሆንዎን ያረጋግጡ።
afaan_oromo: Fudhachuu kee dura umuriin kee waggaa 18 ykn isaa ol ta'uu mirkaneessi.

english: Confirming reserves this total from your balance. Adding funds does not hold the offer;eligibility and time are checked again.
amharic: ማረጋገጥ ይህን ጠቅላላ መጠን ከቀሪ ሂሳብዎ ይይዛል። ገንዘብ መጨመር አማራጩን አይይዝም፤ ጊዜና ብቁነት ዳግም ይረጋገጣሉ።
afaan_oromo: Mirkaneessuun maallaqa kana herrega kee irraa qaba. Maallaqa dabaluu qofaan dhiyeessichi hin qabamu;gahumsii fi yeroon deebiʼanii mirkanaaʼu.

english: Connected presence and a free opening are required.
Connection interrupted; request availability may expire.
amharic: ግንኙነቱ ተቋርጧል፤ ጥያቄ የመቀበል ዝግጁነትዎ ሊያበቃ ይችላል።
afaan_oromo: Walqunnamtiin addaan cite; qophiin gaaffii fudhachuu dhumuu danda'a.

english: Consultation note shared with the patient

afaan_oromo: Gaaffii fi deebii marii ykn madaallii

amharic: የስራ ሰዓትን ወደ ሌሎች ቀናት ቅዳ
afaan_oromo: Yeroo hojii gara guyyaa biraatti garagalchi

english: Copy the link from the field.
Correct the details in the form above and submit again. The rejected application stays in your history.
amharic: በላይ ያለውን ቅጽ ያስተካክሉና እንደገና ያስገቡ። ውድቅ የተደረገው ማመልከቻ በታሪክዎ ውስጥ ይቆያል።
afaan_oromo: Odeeffannoo fooyyessiitii irra deebi'ii dhiyeessi. Iyyannoon didame seenaa kee keessatti ni hafa.

english: Could not load this request. Check your connection and try again.
amharic: ይህን ጥያቄ መጫን አልተቻለም። ግንኙነትዎን ይፈትሹና እንደገና ይሞክሩ።
afaan_oromo: Gaaffii kana fe'uun hin danda'amne. Walqunnamtii kee ilaaliitii irra deebi'ii yaali.

english: Could not load this transaction. Check your connection and try again.
amharic: ይህን ግብይት መጫን አልተቻለም። ግንኙነትዎን ይፈትሹና እንደገና ይሞክሩ።
afaan_oromo: Daldala kana fe'uun hin danda'amne. Walqunnamtii kee ilaaliitii irra deebi'ii yaali.

english: Could not update request availability. Review the setup items and try again.
amharic: የጥያቄ መቀበል ሁኔታን ማዘመን አልተቻለም። የማዋቀር ክፍሎቹን ይመልከቱና እንደገና ይሞክሩ።
afaan_oromo: Haala gaaffii fudhachuu fooyyessuun hin danda'amne. Qophii ilaaliitii irra deebi'ii yaali.

english: Country suggested from your connection. You can change it.
afaan_oromo: Biyyi walqunnamtii kee irraa tilmaamame. Jijjiiruu dandeessa.

english: Create a private link and share it directly with the intended person. Anyone who receives the link can try to accept it, so share it carefully.
amharic: የግል አገናኝ ይፍጠሩና ለታሰበው ሰው ብቻ ያጋሩ። አገናኙን የያዘ ሰው ሊቀበለው ስለሚችል በጥንቃቄ ያጋሩ።
afaan_oromo: Geessituu dhuunfaa uumii nama yaadde qofaaf qoodi. Namni geessituu argatu fudhachuu yaalu danda'a; of eeggannoodhaan qoodi.

english: Create an offering after its service scope is approved.
amharic: የሙያ ፈቃድ ከተሰጠ በኋላ አገልግሎት ያዘጋጁ።
afaan_oromo: Daangaan tajaajilaa erga hayyamamee booda tajaajila uumi.

english: Create an optional adult relationship link. It does not share clinical records or appointments.
amharic: አማራጭ የጎልማሶች ግንኙነት አገናኝ ይፍጠሩ። የሕክምና መዝገቦችን ወይም ቀጠሮዎችን አያጋራም።
afaan_oromo: Walitti hidhamiinsa filannoo namoota ga'eessotaaf uumi. Galmee yaalaa ykn beellama hin qoodu.

english: Create tailored offerings within your approved scopes.
amharic: በተፈቀዱ የሙያ ወሰኖች ውስጥ አገልግሎቶችን ያዘጋጁ።
afaan_oromo: Daangaa hayyamame keessatti tajaajiloota kee qopheessi.

amharic: Yoo jiraate guyyaa ragaan itti dhumu
afaan_oromo: Yoo jiraate guyyaa ragaan itti dhumu

english: Credential re-verification for an existing scope. A reviewer must approve it before expired credentials can be used.
amharic: ለነባር የአገልግሎት ወሰን የማረጋገጫ ዳግም ግምገማ። ጊዜው ያለፈ ማረጋገጫ ከመጠቀሙ በፊት ገምጋሚ ማጽደቅ አለበት።
afaan_oromo: Ragga daangaa duraan jiru irra deebi'anii mirkaneessuu. Ragaan yeroon isaa darbe itti fayyadamuun dura madaalaan hayyamu qaba.

english: Credential renewal for a previously approved scope. Check the new credential evidence and validity dates; do not treat the earlier approval as renewed.
amharic: ቀድሞ ለተፈቀደ ወሰን የማረጋገጫ ማደሻ ነው። አዲሱን ማስረጃና ትክክለኛነት ቀኖች ይመርምሩ፤ የቀድሞው ፈቃድ ታድሷል ብለው አይቁጠሩ።
afaan_oromo: Ragga daangaa duraan hayyamame haaromsuu dha. Ragaa haaraa fi guyyaa hojii isaa ilaalaa; hayyamni duraanii akka haaromfameetti hin fudhatinaa.
Yoo jiraate, guyyaa hayyamni itti jalqabu

english: Credential verification history could not be verified.
afaan_oromo: Seenaa mirkaneessa ragaa mirkaneessuun hin danda'amne.

english: Decision recorded. The historical difference remains preserved.
amharic: ውሳኔው ተመዝግቧል። የታሪክ ልዩነቱ እንዳለ ይጠበቃል።
afaan_oromo: Murtiin galmaa'eera. Garaagarummaan seenaa akkuma jirutti eegama.

english: Defaults help start a booking. You can change sharing for each appointment without changing these preferences.
amharic: ነባሪ ምርጫዎች ቀጠሮ ለመጀመር ያግዛሉ። እነዚህን ሳይቀይሩ ለእያንዳንዱ ቀጠሮ ማጋራትን መቀየር ይችላሉ።
afaan_oromo: Filannoowwan kun beellama jalqabuuf gargaaru. Isaan osoo hin jijjiirin beellama hundaaf qoodinsa jijjiiruu dandeessa.

english: Definitions remain drafts until medical-lead review. Clinician scope approval is a separate decision.
amharic: የአገልግሎት ትርጉሞች እስከ ሕክምና መሪ ግምገማ ድረስ ረቂቅ ይሆናሉ። የባለሙያ አገልግሎት ፈቃድ የተለየ ውሳኔ ነው።
afaan_oromo: Hiikoonni hanga gamaaggama hogganaa yaalaatti wixinee ta'u. Hayyamni damee tajaajilaa ogeessaa murtii addaati.
Gaʼuun hin beekamne;irra deebiʼamee hin ergamne

english: Describe the support you’re looking for.
Describe what you are looking for
Describe what you need, browse specialists, or ask available clinicians to respond.
amharic: የሚፈልጉትን ይግለጹ፣ ባለሙያዎችን ያስሱ ወይም የሚገኙ ባለሙያዎችን ምላሽ ይጠይቁ።
afaan_oromo: Waan barbaaddu ibsi, ogeessota ilaali ykn ogeessota jiran deebii gaafadhu.

english: Describe your qualification, registration and the services you would like reviewed. Upload a PDF resume (up to 5 MB); receipt does not mean your credentials are verified.
amharic: ብቃትዎን፣ ምዝገባዎን እና እንዲገመገሙ የሚፈልጉትን አገልግሎቶች ይግለጹ። እስከ 5 MB የPDF የሥራ ማጠቃለያ ይጫኑ፤ መቀበል ማስረጃዎችዎ ተረጋግጠዋል ማለት አይደለም።
afaan_oromo: Ulaagaa, galmee fi tajaajiloota akka ilaalaman barbaaddu ibsi. Seenaa hojii PDF hanga 5 MB olkaa’i; fudhatamuun isaa ragaan kee mirkanaa’e jechuu miti.

english: Do not include another participant’s private intake. Published revisions remain in the recipient’s sharing history.
amharic: የሌላ ተሳታፊን የግል መረጃ አያካትቱ። የታተሙ ክለሳዎች በተቀባዩ የማጋራት ታሪክ ውስጥ ይቀራሉ።
afaan_oromo: Odeeffannoo dhuunfaa hirmaataa biraa hin dabaliin. Fooyya'iinsi maxxanfame seenaa qoodinsa fudhataa keessa tura.

english: Document could not be removed. Try again.
afaan_oromo: Sanadichi hin haqamne. Irra deebiʼi yaali.

english: Documents and credential identifiers are private to you and authorized reviewers.
amharic: ሰነዶችና የማስረጃ መለያዎች ለእርስዎና ለተፈቀዱ ገምጋሚዎች ብቻ ናቸው።
afaan_oromo: Sanadoonni fi eenyummeessitoonni ragaa siifi gamaaggamtoota hayyamamaniif qofa mul’atu.

english: Documents are private to authorized reviewers.
Draft and paused schedules are not available for booking or requests. Choose Published and save when ready.
amharic: ረቂቅ እና የታገዱ መርሐ ግብሮች ለቀጠሮ ወይም ጥያቄ አይቀርቡም። ዝግጁ ሲሆኑ Published ይምረጡ እና ያስቀምጡ።
afaan_oromo: Sagantaaleen Wixinee fi dhaabbatan beellama yookaan gaaffiidhaaf hin banaman. Yeroo qophooftu Published filadhuutii olkaa'i.

english: Draft definition saved. It is not bookable.
afaan_oromo: Qabannoon olkaa'ameera. Beellamaaf ammallee hin jiru.

english: Draft saved. Publish it to enable bookings.
Drag to position your photo, or use the sliders. Nothing uploads until you save.
amharic: ፎቶዎን በመጎተት ወይም በተንሸራታቾቹ ያስተካክሉ። እስኪያስቀምጡ ድረስ አይሰቀልም።
afaan_oromo: Suuraa harkisuun ykn to’annoo fayyadamuun sirreessaa. Hanga olkeessitanitti hin fe’amu.

english: Drop a file here, or choose a file
amharic: ፋይል እዚህ ጎትተው ይጣሉ ወይም ይምረጡ

english: Drop files here, or choose files
amharic: ፋይሎችን እዚህ ጎትተው ይጣሉ ወይም ይምረጡ

english: Each adult chooses what to share. One participant pays the total session price after both consent.
amharic: እያንዳንዱ ጎልማሳ የሚያጋራውን ይመርጣል። ሁለቱም ከተስማሙ በኋላ አንዱ ጠቅላላ ዋጋውን ይከፍላል።
afaan_oromo: Ga'eessi hundi waan qoodu filata. Lamaan erga walii galanii booda hirmaataan tokko gatii guutuu kaffala.

english: Each adult signs in independently before choosing what to share.
amharic: እያንዳንዱ አዋቂ ምን እንደሚያጋራ ከመምረጡ በፊት በራሱ መለያ ይገባል።
afaan_oromo: Gaʼeessi hundi maal qooduu akka filatu dura of dandaʼee seena.

english: Each approved scope permits matching offerings. The clinician publishes an offering and availability before discovery or requests. Expired or revoked approval blocks new bookings; existing appointments remain preserved for operational review. Vetting permissions never grant private patient-record access.
amharic: እያንዳንዱ የጸደቀ አገልግሎት ተዛማጅ አቅርቦትን ይፈቅዳል። ባለሙያው በፍለጋና በጥያቄዎች ለመገኘት አቅርቦትና ጊዜ ሰሌዳ ማተም አለበት። ያለፈ ወይም የተሻረ ፈቃድ አዲስ ቀጠሮን ይከለክላል፤ የቀድሞ መዝገቦች ይቀመጣሉ። የግምገማ ፈቃድ የታካሚ መዝገብ መዳረሻ አይሰጥም።
afaan_oromo: Tajaajilli hayyamame tokkoon tokkoon dhiyeessii isaa hayyama. Ogeessi argamuu fi gaaffii fudhachuuf dhiyeessii fi yeroo isaa maxxansa. Hayyamni yeroon darbe ykn haqame beellama haaraa ni dhorka; galmeen duraanii ni tura. Hayyamni gamaaggamaa qaqqabummaa galmee dhukkubsataa hin kennu.

english: Each consultation keeps its original disclosure. Private encounters stay separate; later profile changes do not reveal earlier information.
amharic: እያንዳንዱ ምክክር መጀመሪያ የተጋራውን መረጃ ይጠብቃል። የግል ክፍለ ጊዜዎች ተለይተው ይቆያሉ፤ የኋላ መገለጫ ለውጦች የቀድሞ መረጃን አያሳዩም።
afaan_oromo: Mariin hundi qoodinsa jalqabaa eega. Mariileen dhuunfaa addaan turu; jijjiiramni ibsa boodaa odeeffannoo duraa hin mulʼisu.

english: Each file is a snapshot shared with its treating clinician. Revoking stops future access; previously viewed material cannot be recalled. Retention is pending governance review.
amharic: እያንዳንዱ ፋይል ለተመደበው ባለሙያ የተጋራ ቅጂ ነው። መሻር የወደፊት መዳረሻን ያቋርጣል፤ የታየውን አይመልስም። የማቆያ ፖሊሲ ግምገማ ይጠብቃል።
afaan_oromo: Faayiliin hundi garagalcha ogeessa beellamaa wajjin qoodame dha. Haquun seensa gara fuulduraa dhaaba;kan duraan ilaalame deebisuu hin dandaʼu. Imaammanni kuusaa gamaaggama eega.

english: Each service needs its own human approval before publication.
amharic: እያንዳንዱ አገልግሎት ከመታተሙ በፊት በሰው ፈቃድ ይፈልጋል።
afaan_oromo: Tajaajilli hundi maxxanfamuu dura hayyama namaa adda isaa barbaada.

english: Each service scope is reviewed separately before you offer it.
amharic: ከማቅረብዎ በፊት እያንዳንዱ አገልግሎት ለብቻው ይገመገማል።
afaan_oromo: Tajaajilli hundi dhiyaachuu dura adda addaan sakatta’ama.

english: Eligible clinicians can propose a time within your requested window.
amharic: ብቁ ባለሙያዎች በጠየቁት ጊዜ ውስጥ ቀጠሮ ሊያቀርቡ ይችላሉ።
afaan_oromo: Ogeeyyiin ulaagaa guutan yeroo ati gaafatte keessatti yeroo siif dhiheessuu danda’u.

english: Eligible clinicians review only your chosen disclosure.
amharic: ብቁ ባለሙያዎች የመረጡትን መጋራት ብቻ ይገምግማሉ።
afaan_oromo: Ogeessonni ulaagaa guutan qoodinsa filatte qofa ilaalu.

amharic: ብቁ ምላሽ ሰጪ ቡድኖች እና ምርጫዎች
afaan_oromo: Gareewwan deebii ulaagaalee guutanii fi filannoowwan

english: Email codes are unavailable on this site. Choose password sign-in if you already have an account.
amharic: በዚህ ጣቢያ የኢሜይል ኮዶች አይገኙም። መለያ ካለዎት በይለፍ ቃል መግባትን ይምረጡ።
afaan_oromo: Koodiin imeelii marsariitii kana irratti hin jiru. Herrega yoo qabda ta'e jecha iccitiitiin seenuu filadhu.

amharic: ኢሜይል/የይለፍ ቃል ወይም የተረጋገጠ መገናኛ ኮድ
afaan_oromo: Imeelii/jecha iccitii ykn koodii quunnamtii mirkanaa'e

english: Ends the consultation for everyone. Room closure must be confirmed before finalizing notes.
amharic: ምክክሩን ለሁሉም ያጠናቅቃል። ማስታወሻዎችን ከማጠናቀቅ በፊት የክፍሉ መዘጋት መረጋገጥ አለበት።
afaan_oromo: Marii nama hundaaf xumura. Yaadannoo xumuruun dura cufamuun kutaa mirkanaaʼuu qaba.

english: Enter a positive amount with at most two decimal places.
amharic: አዎንታዊ መጠን እስከ ሁለት አስርዮሽ ቦታዎች ያስገቡ።
afaan_oromo: Hanga zeeroo ol ta'e lakkoofsa kudhan keessaa bakka lama qofa qabu galchi.

english: Enter a positive price with at most two decimal places.
amharic: እስከ ሁለት አስርዮሽ ቦታዎች ያለው አዎንታዊ ዋጋ ያስገቡ።
afaan_oromo: Gatii zeeroo ol, bakka deesimaalii lama hin caalle galchaa.

english: Enter a preferred name or alias.
amharic: የመረጡትን ስም ወይም ቅጽል ስም ያስገቡ።
afaan_oromo: Maqaa filatame ykn maqaa masoo galchi.

english: Enter a reason for this decision.
Enter a specific decision reason, up to 2000 characters.
amharic: እስከ 2000 ቁምፊዎች ድረስ ግልጽ የውሳኔ ምክንያት ያስገቡ።
afaan_oromo: Sababaa murtii ifaa hanga arfiilee2000 galchi.

english: Enter a valid credential check date that is not in the future.
amharic: የወደፊት ያልሆነ ትክክለኛ የማረጋገጫ ቀን ያስገቡ።
afaan_oromo: Guyyaa sakatta'iinsaa sirrii kan gara fuulduraa hin taane galchi.

english: Enter a valid credential verification date.
Enter a valid effective date or leave the optional date empty.
amharic: ትክክለኛ የመጀመሪያ ቀን ያስገቡ ወይም አማራጭ ቀኑን ባዶ ይተዉ።
afaan_oromo: Guyyaa jalqabaa sirrii galchi ykn guyyaa filannoo duwwaa dhiisi.

english: Enter a valid IANA timezone, such as Africa/Addis_Ababa.
amharic: እንደ Africa/Addis_Ababa ያለ ትክክለኛ የIANA የሰዓት ክልል ያስገቡ።
afaan_oromo: Naannoo sa'aatii IANA sirrii kan akka Africa/Addis_Ababa galchi.

english: Enter an amount between ETB 0.01 and ETB 1,000,000.
afaan_oromo: Hanga ETB 0.01 fi ETB 1,000,000 gidduu galchi.

english: Enter the professional name that matches your credentials.
amharic: ከማስረጃዎችዎ ጋር የሚዛመድ የሙያ ስም ያስገቡ።
afaan_oromo: Maqaa ogummaa ragaa kee wajjin walsimu galchi.

english: Evidence and approved scope are required.
Evidence references beside assessment scores are optional. License evidence for credential verification is required before approval.
amharic: ከነጥቦች ጎን ያሉ የማስረጃ ማጣቀሻዎች አማራጭ ናቸው። ከማጽደቅ በፊት የፈቃድ ማስረጃ ያስፈልጋል።
afaan_oromo: Wabiiwwan ragaa qabxii biratti filannoo dha. Mirkaneessa hayyamaaf ragaan hayyamaa hayyama dura barbaachisa.

english: Existing bookings retain their agreed disclosure snapshot. Changing defaults does not rewrite past consent.
amharic: ያሉ ቀጠሮዎች የተስማሙበትን ማጋራት ያቆያሉ። ነባሪ ምርጫን መቀየር ያለፈ ፈቃድን አይቀይርም።
afaan_oromo: Beellamni jiru qoodinsa irratti walii galame eega. Filannoo jijjiiruun hayyama duraa hin jijjiiru.

english: Explain why this decision should be reconsidered.
amharic: ይህ ውሳኔ ለምን እንደገና መታየት እንዳለበት ያብራሩ።
afaan_oromo: Murtiin kun maaliif irra deebi'amee ilaalamuu akka qabu ibsi.

english: Explore approved professionals, published services and clear session fees.
amharic: የተፈቀዱ ባለሙያዎችን፣ አገልግሎቶችን እና ግልጽ ዋጋዎችን ይመልከቱ።
afaan_oromo: Ogeessota hayyamaman,tajaajiloota maxxanfamanii fi kaffaltii ifaa ilaali.

english: Explore your options, at your own pace.
Fictional profile · Not a practitioner listing

english: Only selected adults receive the summary and any note you explicitly share.
amharic: ማጠቃለያውንና በግልጽ የሚያጋሩትን ማስታወሻ የተመረጡት ጎልማሶች ብቻ ይቀበላሉ።
afaan_oromo: Ga'eessota filataman qofa cuunfaa fi yaadannoo ifatti qoodde argatu.

english: Only selected adults receive this summary after finalization.
amharic: ይህን ማጠቃለያ ከማጠናቀቅ በኋላ የተመረጡ አዋቂዎች ብቻ ይቀበላሉ።
afaan_oromo: Cuunfaa kana erga xumuramee ga’eessonni filataman qofa argatu.

english: Only the note and summary shown here will be shared. Finalization records pending earnings; it does not release an external payment.
amharic: እዚህ የሚታየው ማስታወሻና ማጠቃለያ ብቻ ይጋራሉ። ማጠናቀቅ የሚጠብቅ ገቢ ይመዘግባል፤ እውነተኛ ክፍያ አይለቅም።
afaan_oromo: Yaadannoo fi cuunfaa asitti mulʼatan qofa qoodamu. Xumuruun galii eeggataa galmeessa; kaffaltii alaa hin gadi lakkisu.

english: Only the requesting patient sees your quote.
amharic: አቅርቦትዎን የሚያየው ጠያቂው ታካሚ ብቻ ነው።
afaan_oromo: Gatii keessan kan argu dhukkubsataa gaafate qofa.

english: Only the selected adult receives this message
amharic: ይህን መልዕክት የተመረጠው አዋቂ ብቻ ይቀበላል
afaan_oromo: Ergaa kana ga'eessi filatame qofa argata

english: Only this treating clinician receives your selected history and files.

afaan_oromo: Seenaa fi faayiloota filatte ogeessi kun qofti argata.

english: Only you and authorized reviewers can access your submitted evidence.
amharic: እርስዎና የተፈቀደላቸው ገምጋሚዎች ብቻ የቀረበውን ማስረጃ ያያሉ።
afaan_oromo: Siifi gamaaggamtoonni hayyamaman qofti ragaa dhiyeessite arguu dandaʼu.

amharic: ይህን ማየት የሚችሉት እርስዎ ብቻ ነዎት
afaan_oromo: Kana arguu kan dandaʼu si qofa

english: Only you can see your photo. It is not shared in requests or consultations.
amharic: ፎቶዎን እርስዎ ብቻ ያያሉ። በጥያቄዎች ወይም ምክክሮች አይጋራም።

english: Only your own quote is shown. Other clinician offers stay private.
amharic: የእርስዎ ዋጋ ብቻ ይታያል። የሌሎች ባለሙያዎች ዋጋ በግል ይቆያል።
afaan_oromo: Gatiin kee qofti mulʼata. Gatiin ogeeyyii biroo dhuunfaa taʼee tura.

afaan_oromo: Gaaffiiwwan banaa, yeroon isaanii darbee fi haqaman

english: Open one service application. Review its qualifications and private evidence. A resume describes experience; a License or registration document supports the credential check. Documents must be attached to this particular scope.
amharic: አንድ የአገልግሎት ማመልከቻ ይክፈቱ። ብቃቶችንና የግል ማስረጃን ይገምግሙ። የሥራ ልምድ ሰነድ ልምድን ይገልጻል፤ የፈቃድ ወይም ምዝገባ ሰነድ ማረጋገጫን ይደግፋል። ሰነዶች ከዚህ ማመልከቻ ጋር መያያዝ አለባቸው።
afaan_oromo: Iyyata tajaajila tokko bani. Barnootaa fi ragaa dhuunfaa gamaaggami. CV muuxannoo ibsa; galmeen hayyamaa ykn galmee mirkaneessa deeggara. Galmeewwan iyyata kanaaf maxxanfamuu qabu.

english: Open only the encounters you treated. Clinic affiliation does not grant access.
amharic: እርስዎ የተከታተሏቸውን ግንኙነቶች ብቻ ይክፈቱ። የክሊኒክ ግንኙነት ፈቃድ አይሰጥም።

english: Open requests are not an emergency response service.

Open times in the next 14 days

afaan_oromo: Qoodinsi dhukkubsataa marii hundaaf addaan filatama.

english: Patients can match requests to only the languages you select here.
amharic: ታካሚዎች ጥያቄዎችን እዚህ ከመረጧቸው ቋንቋዎች ጋር ብቻ ማዛመድ ይችላሉ።

english: Patients choose a published appointment time
Patients should know exactly what they are booking.

english: Payment review requested. The related simulated earnings are on hold.
amharic: የክፍያ ግምገማ ተጠይቋል። ተያያዥ የሙከራ ገቢ ታግዷል።

english: Payout request saved. No external transfer was made.
amharic: የክፍያ ጥያቄው ተመዝግቧል። ውጫዊ ማስተላለፍ አልተደረገም።

amharic: የተገናኘ የግል እንክብካቤ። ጎልማሶች 18+ · የድንገተኛ ጊዜ አገልግሎት አይደለም።

amharic: በነጻ ይለጥፉ እና የግል ቅናሾችን ያወዳድሩ።
afaan_oromo: Bilisa maxxansi, yaadota dhuunfaa wal bira qabi.

english: Post what you need, compare private offers and choose before funds are reserved.
amharic: ፍላጎትዎን ያትሙ፣ የግል ምላሾችን ያነጻጽሩና ገንዘብ ከመያዙ በፊት ይምረጡ።
afaan_oromo: Waan barbaaddu maxxansi, yaada gatii dhuunfaa wal bira qabiitii maallaqni qabamuu dura filadhu.

english: Posting is free. Your balance is checked only when you accept an offer.
amharic: ጥያቄ ማቅረብ ነፃ ነው። ቀሪ ሂሳብዎ የሚረጋገጠው አቅርቦት ሲቀበሉ ብቻ ነው።
afaan_oromo: Gaaffii maxxansuun bilisa. Hafteen keessan kan ilaalamu yeroo yaada dhiyaate fudhattan qofa.

english: Prefer clinicians to respond? Post a private request
amharic: ባለሙያዎች እንዲመልሱ ይፈልጋሉ? የግል ጥያቄ ያቅርቡ
afaan_oromo: Ogeessonni akka deebisan barbaadda? Gaaffii dhuunfaa dhiyeessi

english: Prepare, meet, document privately and choose what to share afterward.
amharic: ይዘጋጁ፣ ይገናኙ፣ የግል ማስታወሻ ያስቀምጡና የሚጋሩትን ይምረጡ።

amharic: ባለሙያዎ የሚያየውን በትክክል አስቀድመው ይመልከቱ። ከፈለጉ ቅጽል ስም ይጠቀሙ።
afaan_oromo: Waan ogeessi kee argu sirriitti durargii. Yoo barbaadde maqaa biraa fayyadami.

afaan_oromo: Qabiyyeen duraan qoodame dursee ilaalamee jiraachuu dandaʼa.

english: Private to the treating clinician unless you choose to share.
amharic: ለማጋራት ካልመረጡ በስተቀር ለእርስዎ ብቻ የግል ነው።
afaan_oromo: Qooduuf yoo hin filanne ogeessa yaalaa qofaaf dhuunfaa dha.

amharic: ከተፈቀደላቸው የአእምሮ ጤና እና የምክር ባለሙያዎች ጋር የግል የድምፅ እና የቪዲዮ ምክክሮች።

afaan_oromo: Ibsa ogummaa fi daangaa tajaajilaa gamaaggami
Gahee ogummaa kee kilinikaa kana keessatti

amharic: የሕክምና መሪው የአገልግሎት መግለጫን፣ የማስረጃ መስፈርቶችንና የተደገፉ ሂደቶችን ይገምግማል። ረቂቅ አገልግሎት ማመልከቻ ሊቀበል ይችላል፤ ሥራ ለመሥራት ፈቃድ አይሰጥም።
afaan_oromo: Hoogganaan yaalaa hiika tajaajilaa, ulaagaa ragaa fi adeemsa deeggarame gamaaggama. Tajaajilli wixinee iyyata fudhachuu danda’a; hojii hojjechuuf hin hayyamu.

english: The original appointment stays reserved until both adults and the clinician agree.
amharic: ሁለቱ ጎልማሶችና ባለሙያው እስኪስማሙ ድረስ ዋናው ቀጠሮ ይቆያል።
afaan_oromo: Ga’eessonni lamaan fi ogeessi hanga walii galanitti beellamni duraa qabamee tura.

english: The original appointment stays reserved until both of you agree.
amharic: ሁለታችሁም እስክትስማሙ ድረስ የመጀመሪያው ቀጠሮ እንደተያዘ ይቆያል።
afaan_oromo: Hanga lamaan keessan walii galtanitti beellamni jalqabaa qabamee jiraata.

english: The patient accepted your offer. Open the appointment for its join window and next steps.
amharic: ታካሚው አቅርቦትዎን ተቀብሏል። የመግቢያ ጊዜውን እና ቀጣይ እርምጃዎችን ለማየት ቀጠሮውን ይክፈቱ።
afaan_oromo: Dhukkubsataan yaada keessan fudhateera. Yeroo itti seentanii fi tarkaanfii itti aanuuf beellama banaa.

english: The patient authorized this disclosure for this request.
amharic: ታካሚው ይህን መረጃ ለዚህ ጥያቄ ፈቅዷል።
afaan_oromo: Fayyadamaan odeeffannoo kana gaaffii kanaaf hayyame.

english: The patient chose what to share for this request. Do not use it outside this response.
amharic: ታካሚው ለዚህ ጥያቄ የሚጋራውን መርጧል። ከዚህ ምላሽ ውጭ አይጠቀሙበት።
afaan_oromo: Dhukkubsataan gaaffii kanaaf waan qoodu filateera. Deebii kanaan ala itti hin fayyadaminaa.

english: The patient will no longer be able to accept this quote.
afaan_oromo: Dhukkubsataan gatii kana fudhachuu hin dandaʼu.

english: The PDF must be 5 MB or smaller.
amharic: PDFው 5 ሜባ ወይም ከዚያ ያነሰ መሆን አለበት።
afaan_oromo: PDF'n 5 MB ykn isaa gadi ta'uu qaba.

english: The resume could not be uploaded. Choose a valid PDF and try again.
amharic: የሥራ ማጠቃለያው ሊጫን አልቻለም። ትክክለኛ PDF ይምረጡ እና እንደገና ይሞክሩ።
afaan_oromo: Seenaa hojii olkaa’uu hin danda’amne. PDF sirrii filadii irra deebi’i.

english: The selected file could not be read.
The service catalog is present in draft and remains non-bookable until the medical lead approves its terminology and local credential requirements.
amharic: Tarreen tajaajilaa wixinee dha; hogganaan yaalaa jechootaafi ulaagaa ragaa biyya keessaa hanga mirkaneessutti beellamni hin banamu.
afaan_oromo: Tarreen tajaajilaa wixinee dha; hogganaan yaalaa hanga mirkaneessutti beellamni hin banamu.

english: The service definition needs medical-lead approval before a clinician can be approved for it.
amharic: ባለሙያው ከመፈቀዱ በፊት የአገልግሎት መግለጫው የሕክምና መሪ ፈቃድ ያስፈልገዋል።
afaan_oromo: Ogeessi hayyamamuu dura hiikni tajaajilaa hayyama hoogganaa yaalaa barbaada.

english: The sharing preview is unavailable. This offer may have expired.
amharic: የማጋራት ቅድመ ዕይታ አይገኝም። የአማራጩ ጊዜ አልፎ ሊሆን ይችላል።
afaan_oromo: Durargiin qoodinsaa hin jiru. Yeroon dhiyeessichaa darbuu dandaʼa.

english: The vetting queue could not be loaded.
These definitions are metadata only. Runtime intake collection and validation are not implemented yet.
amharic: እነዚህ መግለጫዎች የመረጃ መለያዎች ብቻ ናቸው። በሥራ ላይ የሚሰበሰብና የሚረጋገጥ ቅጽ ገና አልተሠራም።
afaan_oromo: Amaloonni kun odeeffannoo qofa. Odeeffannoo yeroo hojii walitti qabuun fi mirkaneessuun ammallee hin hojjatamne.

english: These files are private to you. Uploading does not share them with a clinician; the history-sharing choice applies to your text only.
amharic: እነዚህ ፋይሎች ለእርስዎ ብቻ ናቸው። መጫን ለባለሙያ አያጋራቸውም፤ የታሪክ ማጋራት ምርጫ ለጽሑፍዎ ብቻ ይሠራል።
afaan_oromo: Faayiloonni kun dhuunfaa keeti. Ol feʼuun ogeessaaf hin qoodu; filannoon seenaa qooduu barreeffama kee qofa ilaala.

english: These permissions cover clinic operations only. Patient charts remain restricted to encounter-specific grants.
amharic: እነዚህ ፈቃዶች ለክሊኒክ ሥራ ብቻ ናቸው። የታካሚ መዝገቦች በተለይ በተፈቀደ የምክክር መዳረሻ ብቻ ይከፈታሉ።
afaan_oromo: Hayyamni kun hojii kilinikaa qofaaf. Galmeen dhukkubsataa hayyama marii addaa malee hin banamu.

english: These previous entries are not selectable catalog approaches. Move them to your training description or remove them before saving.
amharic: እነዚህ የቀድሞ ግቤቶች ሊመረጡ የሚችሉ ዘዴዎች አይደሉም። ከማስቀመጥዎ በፊት ወደ ስልጠና መግለጫ ያንቀሳቅሱ ወይም ያስወግዱ።
afaan_oromo: Galteewwan duraanii kun maloota filataman miti. Olkaa'uu dura gara ibsa leenjii geessi ykn haqi.

english: This account has a patient profile. Use your professional account to apply; your existing profile and permissions are unchanged.
amharic: ይህ መለያ የታካሚ መገለጫ አለው። ለማመልከት የባለሙያ መለያዎን ይጠቀሙ፤ መገለጫዎና ፈቃዶችዎ አልተለወጡም።
afaan_oromo: Herregni kun piroofaayilii fayyadamaa qaba. Iyyachuuf herrega ogeessaa kee fayyadami;piroofaayilii fi hayyamni kee hin jijjiiramne.

english: This adds demonstration funds only. No external payment is processed.
amharic: ይህ ለማሳያ ብቻ ገንዘብ ይጨምራል። እውነተኛ ክፍያ አይፈጸምም።
afaan_oromo: Kun maallaqa agarsiisaa qofa dabala. Kaffaltiin alaa hin raawwatamu.

english: This appointment could not be loaded. Check your access and try again.
amharic: ቀጠሮው አልተጫነም። ፈቃድዎን ያረጋግጡና እንደገና ይሞክሩ።
afaan_oromo: Beellamni hin feʼamne. Hayyama kee ilaaliitii irra deebiʼi yaali.

english: This appointment is not eligible for a time change.
afaan_oromo: Beellama kanaaf yeroo jijjiiruun hin danda'amu.

english: This background is not included in your default disclosure. Preview before every booking.
amharic: ይህ ታሪክ በነባሪ የማጋራት ምርጫዎ ውስጥ አልተካተተም። ከእያንዳንዱ ቀጠሮ በፊት ቅድመ እይታ ያድርጉ።
afaan_oromo: Seenaan kun qoodinsa durtii keessatti hin hammatamu. Beellama hunda dura durargii ilaali.

english: This creates a new revision. Previously shared content remains in the sharing history.
amharic: ይህ አዲስ ክለሳ ይፈጥራል። ከዚህ በፊት የተጋራ ይዘት በማጋሪያ ታሪክ ይቀራል።
afaan_oromo: Kun fooyyaʼinsa haaraa uuma. Qabiyyeen duraan qoodame seenaa qoodinsa keessatti hafa.
Hayyamni Kun Yeroo Itti Dhumu Hin Qabu

english: This credential has expired. The service is paused until a reviewer approves updated credentials.
amharic: የዚህ ማረጋገጫ ጊዜ አልፏል። ገምጋሚ የዘመኑ ማረጋገጫዎችን እስኪያጸድቅ ድረስ አገልግሎቱ ታግዷል።

english: This delivery could not be retried. Refresh to check its status.
amharic: እንደገና መላክ አልተቻለም። ሁኔታውን ለማየት ያድሱ።
afaan_oromo: Irra deebiʼanii erguun hin dandaʼamne. Haala isaa ilaaluuf haaromsi.

english: This draft has not been sent to clinicians. It stays in this tab’s memory and will be lost on refresh. Open requests are not an emergency response service.
amharic: ይህ ረቂቅ ለባለሙያዎች አልተላከም። ገጹን ሲያድሱ ይጠፋል። ይህ የአደጋ ጊዜ እርዳታ አገልግሎት አይደለም።
afaan_oromo: Wixineen kun ogeessotaaf hin ergamne. Fuula haaromsuun ni bada. Gaaffiin banaan tajaajila hatattamaa miti.

english: This feature is not available in the current view. Continue to the next step.
amharic: ይህ ባህሪ በአሁኑ ገጽ ላይ የለም። ወደ ቀጣዩ ደረጃ ይቀጥሉ።
afaan_oromo: Amalli kun fuula ammaa irratti hin jiru. Gara tarkaanfii itti aanuutti ce'i.

amharic: ይህ መረጃ ለእርስዎና ለሚያክምዎ ባለሙያ ብቻ ነው።

english: This introduction may appear on your approved public profile. Keep credential identifiers in the private application fields.
amharic: ይህ መግቢያ በተፈቀደው የህዝብ መገለጫዎ ላይ ሊታይ ይችላል። የማስረጃ መለያዎችን በግል ማመልከቻ መስኮች ውስጥ ያስቀምጡ።

english: This invitation has expired. Ask the person to send a new one.
amharic: ይህ ግብዣ ጊዜው አልፏል። አዲስ እንዲልኩ ይጠይቁ።
afaan_oromo: Affeerraan kun dhumeera. Haaraa akka ergan gaafadhu.

english: This invitation is for patient accounts. Sign in with a patient account to continue.
amharic: ይህ ግብዣ ለታካሚ መለያ ነው። ለመቀጠል በታካሚ መለያ ይግቡ።
afaan_oromo: Affeerraan kun herrega dhukkubsataaf. Itti fufuuf herrega dhukkubsataatiin seeni.

english: This invitation is no longer available.
afaan_oromo: Affeerraan kun kana booda hin jiru.

english: This is a preview. Nothing is published until you finalize and choose to share.
amharic: ይህ ቅድመ እይታ ነው። እስኪያጠናቅቁና ለማጋራት እስኪመርጡ ድረስ ምንም አይታተምም።
afaan_oromo: Kun ilaalcha duraa dha. Hanga xumurtee qooduuf filattutti homtuu hin maxxanfamu.

english: This is an earlier activity record. Its original history is preserved.
amharic: ይህ የቀድሞ እንቅስቃሴ መዝገብ ነው። የመጀመሪያው ታሪክ ተጠብቆ ቆይቷል።
afaan_oromo: Kun galmee sochii durii dha. Seenaan isaa duraa eegameera.

english: This is saved privately. Your sharing defaults apply; preview and choose what to share before every booking.
amharic: ይህ በግል ይቀመጣል። ነባሪ የማጋራት ምርጫዎችዎ ይተገበራሉ፤ ከእያንዳንዱ ቀጠሮ በፊት ቅድመ እይታ ያድርጉ እና የሚያጋሩትን ይምረጡ።
afaan_oromo: Kun iccitiidhaan kuufama. Filannoon qooduu durtii kee hojii irra oola; beellama hunda dura durargii ilaalii waan qooddu filadhu.

english: This is the disclosure snapshot you accepted when you published the request.
amharic: ጥያቄውን ሲያትሙ የተቀበሉት የማጋራት መረጃ ይህ ነው።
afaan_oromo: Kun yeroo gaaffii maxxansitetti qooduu fudhatte dha.

english: This link expires after the time shown in your invitation list.
amharic: ይህ አገናኝ በግብዣ ዝርዝርዎ ላይ በታየው ሰዓት ያበቃል።
afaan_oromo: Geessituun yeroo tarree affeerraa irratti mul'atu booda dhuma.

english: This note will be included in the patient-visible preview and published when you finalize.
amharic: ይህ ማስታወሻ ለታካሚው በሚታየው ቅድመ እይታ ይካተታል፤ ሲያጠናቅቁም ይታተማል።
afaan_oromo: Yaadannoon kun ilaalcha duraa dhukkubsataa keessatti hammatama; yeroo xumurtu maxxanfama.

amharic: ምላሹ አልተጫነም። ግንኙነትዎን ያረጋግጡ ወይም እንደገና ይግቡ።
afaan_oromo: Yaadni gatii hin feʼamne. Walqunnamtii kee ilaali ykn irra deebiʼii seeni.

english: This offer is no longer available.
This offer is no longer available. Return to your request to see other options.

afaan_oromo: Yaadni kun amma hin jiru. Filannoo biraaf gaaffii keessanitti deebi’aa.

english: This offer is unavailable. Only your own offers can be viewed.
amharic: ይህ ምላሽ አይገኝም። የራስዎን ምላሾች ብቻ ማየት ይችላሉ።
afaan_oromo: Yaadni gatii kun hin jiru. Kan kee qofa ilaaluu dandeessa.
