afaan_oromo: Deebisanii fudhachuun dhiyeessii socho’aa cufa. Dhiyeessiin fudhatame seera haquu beellamaatiin bulfama.

english: Yes. Explore public profiles and services first. Sign in when you choose a service to book or publish a request.
amharic: አዎ። የሕዝብ መገለጫዎችንና አገልግሎቶችን መጀመሪያ ያስሱ። ቀጠሮ ለማስያዝ ወይም ጥያቄ ለማቅረብ ሲመርጡ ይግቡ።
afaan_oromo: Eeyyee. Seenaa uummataa fi tajaajila dursee ilaalaa. Beellama qabachuu ykn gaaffii maxxansuuf seenaa.

english: You are now linked. No appointments or records were shared.
amharic: አሁን ተገናኝተዋል። ቀጠሮም ሆነ መዝገብ አልተጋራም።
afaan_oromo: Amma walitti hidhattaniittu. Beellamni ykn galmeen hin qoodamne.

english: You are signed in to a professional workspace. Use your patient account to book care; no patient role has been added.
amharic: ወደ ባለሙያ መለያ ገብተዋል። ቀጠሮ ለመያዝ የታካሚ መለያዎን ይጠቀሙ፤ የታካሚ ሚና አልተጨመረም።
afaan_oromo: Gara bakka hojii ogeessaatti seenteetta. Beellamaaf herrega fayyadamaa keetii fayyadami;gaheen fayyadamaa hin dabalamu.

english: You can keep waiting or choose later
amharic: መጠበቅ መቀጠል ወይም ሌላ ጊዜ መምረጥ ይችላሉ
afaan_oromo: Eeguu itti fufuu ykn yeroo boodaa filachuu dandeessa

english: You can opt in during published hours while your workspace is connected. A free opening is required, and manual pause always takes priority.
amharic: በታተሙ ሰዓቶች የሥራ ቦታዎ ሲገናኝ መመዝገብ ይችላሉ። ክፍት ጊዜ ያስፈልጋል፤ በእጅ ማቆም ሁልጊዜ ቅድሚያ አለው።
afaan_oromo: Sa’aatii maxxanfame keessatti yeroo walqunnamtan filachuu dandeessu. Yeroon banaan barbaachisa; dhaabbiin harkaan yeroo hunda dursa.

english: You can receive eligible requests while this workspace is connected.
amharic: ይህ የሥራ ገጽ ሲገናኝ ተስማሚ ጥያቄዎችን መቀበል ይችላሉ።
afaan_oromo: Fuulli hojii kun yeroo walqabatu gaaffilee ulaagaa guutan fudhachuu dandeessu.

english: You cannot accept bookings until your application and each requested scope are approved.
amharic: ማመልከቻዎ እና የተጠየቁ የአገልግሎት ወሰኖች እስኪጸድቁ ድረስ ቀጠሮ መቀበል አይችሉም።
afaan_oromo: Iyyannoon kee fi daangaan tajaajilaa tokkoon tokkoon isaa hanga mirkanaa'anitti beellama fudhachuu hin dandeessu.

english: You choose these when booking or posting a request.
amharic: ቀጠሮ ሲይዙ ወይም ጥያቄ ሲለጥፉ እነዚህን ይመርጣሉ።
afaan_oromo: Beellama qabattu ykn gaaffii maxxansitu yeroo filatta.

english: You choose whether to take part. Accepting an invitation does not share your care records.
amharic: መሳተፍ እንደሚፈልጉ እርስዎ ይመርጣሉ። ግብዣን መቀበል የእንክብካቤ መዝገቦችዎን አያጋራም።
afaan_oromo: Hirmaachuu kee ati filatta. Affeerraa fudhachuun galmee kunuunsa kee hin qoodu.

english: You do not have permission to view this request.
afaan_oromo: Gaaffii kana ilaaluuf hayyama hin qabdu.

english: You don’t have access to a clinic workspace.
afaan_oromo: Iddoo hojii kilinikaa seenuuf hayyamni hin jiru.

english: You don’t have permission to change request availability.
amharic: የጥያቄ መቀበል ሁኔታን ለመቀየር ፈቃድ የለዎትም።
afaan_oromo: Haala gaaffii fudhachuu jijjiiruuf hayyama hin qabdu.

english: You paused requests. Start again when you are ready.
amharic: ጥያቄዎችን አቁመዋል። ዝግጁ ሲሆኑ እንደገና ይጀምሩ።
afaan_oromo: Gaaffilee dhaabdan. Yeroo qophooftan deebi’aa jalqabaa.

english: You pay the total session price.
You will have your own account, intake, and consent choices.
amharic: የራስዎ መለያ፣ የግል መረጃና የፈቃድ ምርጫዎች ይኖርዎታል።
afaan_oromo: Herrega, odeeffannoo fi filannoo hayyamaa mataa keetii qabaatta.

english: Your account defaults apply unless you change them for a particular request.
amharic: ለአንድ ጥያቄ ካልቀየሩ በስተቀር የመለያዎ ነባሪ ምርጫዎች ይተገበራሉ።
afaan_oromo: Gaaffii tokkoof yoo hin jijjiirre filannoowwan herrega kee hojii irra oolu.

english: Your agreement does not charge your balance or the other adult’s balance.
amharic: ፈቃድዎ ከእርስዎ ወይም ከሌላው ጎልማሳ ሂሳብ ገንዘብ አይቀንስም።
afaan_oromo: Waliigalteen kee baalansii kee ykn kan ga’eessa biraa hin hir’isu.

english: Your application is saved for manual review.
Your application will be submitted for manual review. You cannot accept bookings until your professional status and service scopes are approved.
amharic: ማመልከቻዎ በሰው ለሚደረግ ግምገማ ይቀርባል። ሙያዊ ሁኔታዎ እና የአገልግሎት ወሰኖችዎ እስኪጸድቁ ድረስ ቀጠሮዎችን መቀበል አይችሉም።
afaan_oromo: Iyyanni kee namaan ilaalamuuf dhiyaata. Haalli ogummaa fi daangaan tajaajilaa kee hanga hayyamamutti beellama fudhachuu hin dandeessu.

english: Your background is included in your default disclosure. Preview before every booking.
amharic: ታሪክዎ በነባሪ የማጋራት ምርጫዎ ውስጥ ተካቷል። ከእያንዳንዱ ቀጠሮ በፊት ቅድመ እይታ ያድርጉ።
afaan_oromo: Seenaan kee qoodinsa durtii keessatti hammatama. Beellama hunda dura durargii ilaali.

english: Your balance could not be loaded.
Your booked time is protected. Requests resume when a full session fits.
amharic: የተያዘው ጊዜዎ የተጠበቀ ነው። ሙሉ ምክክር ሲቻል ጥያቄዎች ይቀጥላሉ።
afaan_oromo: Yeroon qabame eegama. Yeroo marii guutuuf bakka argamu gaaffileen itti fufu.

english: Your care records could not be loaded.
afaan_oromo: Galmeewwan kunuunsa keessanii fe'uun hin danda'amne.

english: Your clinician sees only the information you chose to share for this session.
amharic: ባለሙያዎ ለዚህ ምክክር ለማጋራት የመረጡትን መረጃ ብቻ ያያሉ።
afaan_oromo: Ogeessi kee odeeffannoo marii kanaaf qooduu filatte qofa arga.

english: Your clinician will receive only the information shown below for this booking.
amharic: ለዚህ ቀጠሮ ባለሙያዎ ከታች የታየውን መረጃ ብቻ ይቀበላል።
afaan_oromo: Ogeessi kee beellama kanaaf odeeffannoo armaan gadii qofa argata.

english: Your consultation is in Appointments. Open its details for the join window and device check.
amharic: ምክክርዎ በቀጠሮዎች ውስጥ ነው። የመግቢያ ጊዜንና የመሣሪያ ሙከራን ለማየት ዝርዝሩን ይክፈቱ።
afaan_oromo: Marii kee Beellamoota keessatti argatta. Yeroo itti seentuufi qorannoo meeshaa ilaaluuf balʼina isaa bani.

english: Your details, preferences and privacy, all in one place.
amharic: ዝርዝሮችዎ፣ ምርጫዎችዎ እና ግላዊነትዎ በአንድ ቦታ።
afaan_oromo: Odeeffannoo, filannoo fi iccitii keessan bakka tokkotti.

english: Your document storage is full. Remove an unneeded file before uploading.
amharic: የሰነድ ማከማቻዎ ሞልቷል። ያልፈለጉትን ፋይል ያስወግዱ።
afaan_oromo: Kuusaan sanadoota kee guuteera. Faayilii hin barbaachifne haqi.

english: Your documents could not be loaded. Try again.
afaan_oromo: Sanadoonni kee hin feʼamne. Irra deebiʼi yaali.

english: Your entries stay while you move between steps. A decision is recorded only when you confirm it.
amharic: በደረጃዎች መካከል ሲንቀሳቀሱ ግቤቶችዎ ይቆያሉ። ውሳኔ የሚመዘገበው ሲያረጋግጡ ብቻ ነው።
afaan_oromo: Tarkaanfii gidduu yeroo sochootu galteen kee ni tura. Murtiin yeroo mirkaneessitu qofa galmaa’a.

english: Your existing draft is retained. Resume it, or sign in with the account you want to use. No roles or profile details have changed.
amharic: ያለው ረቂቅዎ ይቆያል። ይቀጥሉበት ወይም በሚፈልጉት መለያ ይግቡ። ሚናዎችና መገለጫ አልተለወጡም።
afaan_oromo: Wixineen kee kuufameera. Itti fufi yookaan herrega barbaaddeen seeni. Gahee fi piroofaayiliin hin jijjiiramne.

english: Your independently reviewed clinic affiliations will appear here.
amharic: በተናጠል የተገመገሙ የክሊኒክ ግንኙነቶችዎ እዚህ ይታያሉ።
afaan_oromo: Walitti dhufeenyi kilinikaa kee addaan gamaaggamame asitti mul'ata.

english: Your next step can be a small one.
afaan_oromo: Tarkaanfiin keessan itti aanu xiqqoo ta’uu danda’a.

english: Your offer is with the patient
Your offer was accepted. Appointment details show its current status and next steps.
amharic: አቅርቦቱ ተቀብሏል። የቀጠሮ ዝርዝሮች አሁን ያለውን ሁኔታ እና ቀጣይ እርምጃዎች ያሳያሉ።
afaan_oromo: Yaadni fudhatameera. Bal’inni beellamaa haala yeroo ammaa fi tarkaanfii itti aanu agarsiisa.

english: Your offerings could not be loaded.
Your offers could not be loaded.
Your photo could not be loaded. Try again.
afaan_oromo: Suuraa kee fe’uun hin danda’amne. Irra deebi’i.

english: Your photo could not be saved. Try again.
afaan_oromo: Suuraa kee ol kaa’uun hin danda’amne. Irra deebi’i.

english: Your preferred name and request text will be shared. Saved history and files stay private until you select a treating clinician.
amharic: የመረጡት ስም እና የጥያቄ ጽሑፍ ይጋራሉ። ባለሙያ እስኪመርጡ ድረስ ታሪክና ፋይሎች የግል ናቸው።
afaan_oromo: Maqaan filattan fi barruun gaaffii keessanii ni qoodamu. Seenaa fi faayiloonni hanga ogeessa filattanitti dhuunfaa ta’u.

english: Your preferred name is used in your account. Sharing it with a clinician is decided for each appointment.
amharic: የመረጡት ስም በመለያዎ ይጠቀማል። ከክሊኒሺያን ጋር ማጋራት ለእያንዳንዱ ቀጠሮ ይወሰናል።
afaan_oromo: Maqaan filatte herrega kee keessatti fayyada. Ogeessa waliin qooduun beellama hundaaf addaan murtaa'a.

english: Your previous clinicians could not be loaded.
Your price and sharing choices, before booking
afaan_oromo: Gatii fi filannoowwan qoodinsaa beellama dura

english: Your private consultation note stays private. Finalization records completion and pending earnings; it does not release earnings or send an external payment.
amharic: የግል ማስታወሻዎ የግል ሆኖ ይቆያል። ማጠናቀቅ ማጠናቀቁንና የሚጠበቀውን ገቢ ይመዘግባል፤ ገቢን አይለቅም ወይም እውነተኛ ክፍያ አይልክም።
afaan_oromo: Yaadannoon kee dhuunfaa ta'ee hafa. Xumuruun xumuraa fi galii eegamaa galmeessa; galii hin gadhiisu ykn kaffaltii alaa hin ergu.

english: Your private intake is not visible to the other adult.
afaan_oromo: Odeeffannoon dhuunfaa kee gaʼeessa biraaf hin mulʼatu.

english: Your professional evidence stays private to you and authorized reviewers. General approval does not authorize every service. Published offerings stay within your approved scopes.
amharic: የሙያ ማስረጃዎ ለእርስዎና ለተፈቀደላቸው ገምጋሚዎች ብቻ ይታያል። አጠቃላይ ፈቃድ ሁሉንም አገልግሎት አይፈቅድም። አቅርቦቶች በተፈቀዱ ወሰኖች ይቆያሉ።
afaan_oromo: Ragaan ogummaa isinii fi sakatta’oota hayyamamaniif qofa. Hayyamni waliigalaa tajaajila hunda hin hayyamu. Dhiyeessiin daangaa hayyamame keessatti tura.

english: Your professional identity and practice preferences.
afaan_oromo: Eenyummaa ogummaa fi filannoowwan hojii kee.

english: Your profile and privacy defaults are saved.
afaan_oromo: Ibsi kee fi filannoon iccitii olkaa'ameera.

english: Your request and its private responses.
afaan_oromo: Gaaffii kee fi deebiiwwan dhuunfaa isaa ilaali.

english: Your request text is visible to its recipients even when your name is not shared. Avoid names and details that identify you.
amharic: ስምዎ ባይጋራም የጥያቄዎ ጽሑፍ ለተቀባዮቹ ይታያል። የሚለዩዎትን ስሞች እና ዝርዝሮች ያስወግዱ።
afaan_oromo: Maqaan keessan yoo hin qoodamnellee barruun gaaffii fudhattootaaf mul’ata. Maqaa fi waan isin beeksisu irraa of qusadhaa.

english: Your resume is shared with the reviewer. Attach a License or registration PDF to each scope for credential verification. Additional qualification or training evidence supports the individual review.
amharic: የሥራ ልምድ ሰነድዎ ለገምጋሚው ይቀርባል። ለማረጋገጫ የፈቃድ PDF ከእያንዳንዱ ማመልከቻ ጋር ያያይዙ። ተጨማሪ የብቃትና ስልጠና ማስረጃ ግምገማውን ይደግፋል።
afaan_oromo: CV kee gamaaggamaaf qoodama. Mirkaneessaaf PDF hayyamaa iyyata tokkoon tokkootti maxxansi. Ragaan barnootaa fi leenjii dabalataa gamaaggama ni deeggara.

english: Your saved history is not shared unless you choose it for an appointment.
amharic: ለቀጠሮ ካልመረጡት በስተቀር የተቀመጠ ታሪክዎ አይጋራም።
afaan_oromo: Seenaa olkaa'ame beellamaaf yoo filatte qofa qoodama.

english: Your saved progress could not be loaded. Reload to try again.
amharic: የተቀመጠው ሂደትዎ ሊጫን አልቻለም። እንደገና ይጫኑ።
afaan_oromo: Adeemsi kuufame fe’amuu hin dandeenye. Irra deebi’ii fe’i.

english: Your saved progress is retained and has not been submitted. Existing invited accounts can still sign in.
amharic: የተቀመጠ ሂደትዎ ይቆያል፤ አልተላከም። የተጋበዙ መለያዎች መግባት ይችላሉ።
afaan_oromo: Adeemsi kee kuufameera;hin ergamne. Herregoonni duraan affeeraman seenuu dandaʼu.

english: Your saved registration is a different journey
Your saved text history is shared with this treating clinician when you accept.
amharic: ሲቀበሉ የተቀመጠው የጽሑፍ ታሪክዎ ለዚህ ባለሙያ ይጋራል።
